english: Stlpulmsh is a name of the Lower Cowlitz people, whose villages stood along the Cowlitz River north of the Columbia. The river joined a network of paths and waterways through the forests west of the Cascades. Cowlitz weavers made blankets and clothing from mountain goat hair, valued both within families and as gifts and trade goods. In 1812 Robert Stuart of the Pacific Fur Company travelled up the river and recorded the Cowlitz people; the fur trade brought more frequent contact in the following decades.
simp_chinese: 斯特尔普尔姆什是下考利茨人的自称之一，他们的村落沿哥伦比亚河以北的考利茨河分布。河流与道路、水道相连，穿过喀斯喀特山脉以西的森林。考利茨织工用山羊毛制作毯子和衣物，供家人使用，也作为贵重的礼物和交易品。1812年，太平洋毛皮公司的罗伯特·斯图尔特溯河而上，记录了考利茨人；此后数十年，毛皮贸易带来了更频繁的接触。

english: St Matthew Island rises from the central Bering Sea, a remote volcanic island with steep cliffs above cold water. Murres, kittiwakes and fulmars nest on its basalt shore, while Arctic foxes hunt among the tundra and bird colonies. Pack ice surrounds the island in winter. The Russian navigator Ivan Synd charted and named it in 1766, during a voyage through the waters between Asia and America.
simp_chinese: 圣马修岛拔起于白令海中部，是一座偏远的火山岛，陡峭崖壁俯临寒冷海水。海鸦、三趾鸥和暴风鹱在玄武岩海岸筑巢，北极狐则在苔原与鸟群之间觅食。冬季，浮冰环绕着岛屿。1766年，俄国航海家伊万·辛德在亚洲与美洲之间航行时测绘并命名了此岛。

english: Santo Domingo de Silos grew around a Benedictine monastery in a quiet valley south of Burgos. Its Romanesque cloister is celebrated for paired columns, carved capitals and great reliefs depicting scenes from the life of Christ. The community preserved books and manuscripts as well as its ancient monastic traditions. In the eighteenth century the medieval church was replaced by a new building designed by Ventura Rodríguez, while the sculpted cloister remained at the heart of the monastery.
simp_chinese: 圣多明各德西洛斯围绕布尔戈斯以南宁静山谷中的本笃会修道院发展起来。罗马式回廊以成对石柱、雕刻柱头和表现基督生平的大型浮雕著称。修士们保存书籍与手稿，也延续古老的修院传统。十八世纪，文图拉·罗德里格斯设计的新教堂取代中世纪教堂，雕刻精美的回廊则仍是修道院的核心。

english:
The Stó:lō are peoples of the lower Fraser River and its canyon, where villages and fishing places lie along a waterway rich in salmon. Canoes and trails connected communities across the valley and beyond, while the river's annual fish runs sustained both households and exchange. Among these communities were the Kwantlen, whose traditional territory extended along the lower river.

In 1808 Simon Fraser traveled downriver with Indigenous guides. The Hudson's Bay Company established Fort Langley on the lower Fraser in 1827, seeking fur trade with the people of the region. Kwantlen chief Whattlekainum encouraged the company to trade in salmon and cranberries as well. The Kwantlen moved their main village closer to the fort, strengthening their position in the new commerce.
simp_chinese:
斯托洛诸民族生活在弗雷泽河下游及其峡谷，村落和渔场沿着盛产鲑鱼的河道分布。独木舟和小径连接河谷内外的社群，每年洄游的鱼群则为家庭和交换提供资源。这些社群包括宽特伦人，他们的土地沿河流下游延伸。

1808年，西蒙·弗雷泽在原住民向导陪同下顺河而下。1827年，哈德逊湾公司在弗雷泽河下游建立兰利堡，希望与当地居民进行毛皮贸易。宽特伦首领瓦特勒凯纳姆鼓励公司也交易鲑鱼和蔓越莓。宽特伦人将主要村落迁近堡垒，以巩固自己在新贸易中的地位。

english:
Stockach stands in the Hegau country near Lake Constance. The counts of Nellenburg founded the town on a sheltered height in the thirteenth century, above an older village at the meeting of two former Roman roads. In 1465 the town and its surrounding lordship were sold to the Habsburgs, whose officials governed the Nellenburg territory from Stockach for centuries.

Swiss forces besieged the town without success in 1499, during the Swabian War. It suffered more severely in the War of the Spanish Succession, when the Bavarian elector ordered much of it burned in 1704. Stockach remained an important junction for coaches travelling between Vienna, Paris, Zürich and other cities. In 1799 Austrian forces defeated the French near Stockach and Liptingen. Habsburg rule ended in 1805; the town passed first to Württemberg and then to Baden in 1810.
simp_chinese:
施托卡赫位于博登湖附近的黑高地区。十三世纪，内伦堡伯爵在一处受地形保护的高地上建立城镇，山下则有一座旧村，坐落于两条旧罗马道路的交会处。1465年，城镇及周边领地被卖给哈布斯堡家族，此后数百年，哈布斯堡官员从施托卡赫治理内伦堡地区。

1499年施瓦本战争期间，瑞士军队围攻城镇，未能攻下。西班牙王位继承战争带来的破坏更为严重：1704年，巴伐利亚选帝侯下令烧毁城镇的大部分。施托卡赫仍是维也纳、巴黎、苏黎世等城市之间邮车交通的重要交会点。1799年，奥军在施托卡赫与利普廷根附近击败法军。1805年哈布斯堡统治结束，城镇先归符腾堡，1810年又转归巴登。

english:
This town was founded in 1252 by Birger Jarl, on a strategically chosen site where Lake Mälaren meets the Baltic Sea. This allowed Stockholm to serve as both a fortress controlling access to the lake and a trading hub connecting inland Sweden to Hanseatic and Baltic trade networks. By the early 14th century, the iron and copper carried down from the Bergslagen mines, together with the influx of German burghers governing under Lübeck Law, had made Stockholm the foremost town of the Swedish realm.

That wealth made Stockholm the prize of the Kalmar Union, for whoever held it held the kingdom. In 1471 Sten Sture the Elder defeated Christian I of Denmark at Brunkeberg, but in 1520 Christian II took the town and, days after his coronation, had many of its leading nobles and burghers beheaded in the Stockholm Bloodbath. Gustav Vasa won it back three years later, ending the union, and found every second house standing empty.

Under the Vasa kings the burghers lost their old independence, and the town was bound to the crown. In 1634 it became the formal capital of a rising great power, and the government drew the realm's trade into it: from under 10,000 people early in the century it grew to more than 50,000 by the 1670s, while after the fire of 1625 straight new streets and a row of merchant palaces on the quay replaced part of the medieval town. In 1697 the old castle of Tre Kronor burned, and Stockholm Palace rose in its place. Plague in 1710 and defeat in the Great Northern War left the capital of a lost empire to stagnate, until Gustav III gave it a new square and, in 1782, a Royal Opera.
simp_chinese:
这座城镇由雅尔伯吉尔于1252年建立，选址于梅拉伦湖与波罗的海交汇的战略要冲。这一位置使其既能作为控制湖泊通道的堡垒，又可成为连接瑞典内陆与汉萨同盟及波罗的海贸易网络的枢纽。

财富让斯德哥尔摩成了卡尔马联盟时期各方争夺的目标，谁握有这座城，谁就握有王国。1471年，老斯滕·斯图雷在布伦克山击败丹麦国王克里斯蒂安一世；1520年，克里斯蒂安二世攻下城镇，加冕后没几天就把城中许多显赫的贵族和市民斩首，史称斯德哥尔摩血浴。三年后古斯塔夫·瓦萨夺回此城，联盟就此终结，他进城时看到每两座房子就有一座空着。

瓦萨王朝治下，市民失去了往日的自治，城市牢牢系在王权之上。1634年，斯德哥尔摩成为新兴强国的正式首都，朝廷把全国的贸易都往这里集中：17世纪初城中还不到1万人，到1670年代已超过5万。1625年大火之后，旧城的一部分改建成笔直的新街，码头边立起一排富商的宅邸。1697年，旧王宫三王冠城堡焚毁，原址建起了斯德哥尔摩王宫。1710年的瘟疫和大北方战争的失败，让这座失去帝国的首都长期停滞，直到古斯塔夫三世为它修了新广场，又在1782年建起皇家歌剧院。

english: Stockholm's archipelago is a maze of islands, skerries and sheltered sounds guarding the approach to the city. Its narrow channels could protect vessels from the open Baltic but also offered places to block an enemy. During the Russian coastal raids of 1719, fighting broke out at Baggensstäket on a route towards Stockholm. After the engagement the Russian force abandoned its attempt to advance further towards the city.
simp_chinese: 斯德哥尔摩群岛由岛屿、礁岩和受掩护的海峡组成迷宫，守护通往城市的航道。狭窄水道能为船只遮蔽波罗的海的风浪，也便于阻挡敌军。1719年俄国袭击瑞典海岸时，通往斯德哥尔摩的巴根斯泰凯特航道发生战斗；交战后俄军放弃进一步逼近城市。

english:
Stockton is an Anglo-Saxon Settlement on the north bank of the River Tees, and was sparsely populated until the Bishop freed the borough serfs, which made it an attractive place for craftsmen to move to. It became an important market for exporting wool and importing wine, though it would not be home to a significant population until the Industrial Revolution.

The bishops of Durham kept a fortified manor house here, Stockton Castle, first recorded in 1376, and by the 15th century the town was building ships. Shipbuilding and rope-making made it the chief port for County Durham, the North Riding and Westmorland, sending out rope, farm produce and lead from the Yorkshire Dales. The castle did not outlast the Civil War: the Scots held it from 1644 to 1646, and Cromwell had it pulled down once the fighting was over.

The town itself kept growing. In 1771 a stone bridge of five arches replaced the Bishop's Ferry and became the lowest crossing of the Tees, and by the end of the century iron-making and engineering were turning the quiet market town into an industrial one. The decisive change came on 27 September 1825, when George Stephenson drove Locomotion No. 1 on the first journey of the Stockton and Darlington Railway, a line that greatly boosted the town's trade.
simp_chinese:
斯托克顿是位于蒂斯河北岸的一处盎格鲁 - 撒克逊人聚居地，在主教释放了该镇的农奴之前，这里人口稀少，此后才吸引工匠们迁入。它成了出口羊毛和进口葡萄酒的重要集市，不过直到工业革命时期，这里的人口才显著增加。

达勒姆主教在这里有一座设防的庄园宅邸，即斯托克顿城堡，最早见于1376年的记载；到15世纪，镇上已经在造船。造船和制绳使斯托克顿成为达勒姆郡、北赖丁和威斯特摩兰的主要港口，运出绳索、农产品和约克郡山谷出产的铅。城堡没能熬过内战：1644至1646年苏格兰人占据了它，战事一结束，克伦威尔就下令将其拆毁。

小镇本身却在不断成长。1771年，一座五拱石桥取代了主教渡口，成为蒂斯河最靠下游的过河处；到18世纪末，炼铁和机械制造正把这个安静的集镇变成工业城镇。决定性的变化发生在1825年9月27日，乔治·斯蒂芬森驾驶“动力一号”机车，完成了斯托克顿—达灵顿铁路的首次运行，这条铁路让镇上的商业大为兴旺。

english: Stodolichi lies in the forest and marsh country of Polesia, in the wider Ubort region. Written sources record the village in the sixteenth century as church property in the Mozyr district of the Grand Duchy of Lithuania. The surrounding country was dotted with villages among woods and wetlands. After the second partition of the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth in 1793, Stodolichi passed to the Russian Empire.
simp_chinese: 斯托多利奇位于波列西亚的森林和沼泽地带，属于更广阔的乌博尔季地区。十六世纪的文书记载，这座村庄是立陶宛大公国莫济里地区的教会地产。周围村落散布在林木和湿地之间。1793年波兰立陶宛联邦第二次被瓜分后，斯托多利奇归入俄罗斯帝国。

english:
Stoke lies in north Staffordshire, in the district that became known as the Potteries. The later industrial city grew from several separate settlements. Clay, fuel, craft skills and transport helped pottery production expand from local markets to a wider trade.

During the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries, north Staffordshire manufacturers developed wares and methods that changed the reputation of English ceramics. Josiah Wedgwood and other entrepreneurs combined technical experimentation with design and commerce. Canals improved transport for bulky materials and finished goods, helping the district reach distant markets. By the early nineteenth century the pottery towns formed a distinctive manufacturing region, though they retained separate identities.
simp_chinese:
斯托克位于北斯塔福德郡后来以陶器业闻名的地区。此后形成的工业城市由多个原本独立的聚落发展而来。陶土、燃料、工匠技艺和运输条件帮助陶器生产从地方市场逐步扩展到更广的贸易。

十七、十八世纪，北斯塔福德郡制造者开发新器物和工艺，改变了英国陶瓷的声誉。乔赛亚·韦奇伍德等企业家将技术试验与设计和商业结合。运河改善了笨重原料与成品的运输，使产区更容易进入远方市场。到十九世纪前期，陶业城镇形成鲜明的制造地区，但各自仍保有独立身份。

english: Stokes Bay lies among the western channels of the Magellanic archipelago. Nearby, Maule Channel separates the principal islands of the Rice Trevor group, with small coves along its shores. Kawésqar families travelled this intricate maritime country by canoe, moving between the waterways south of the Strait of Magellan.
simp_chinese: 斯托克斯湾位于麦哲伦群岛西部水道之间。附近的毛莱水道将赖斯特雷弗群岛的主要岛屿分开，沿岸散布着小海湾。卡维斯卡尔家庭乘独木舟穿行于这片错综复杂的海上地域，往来于麦哲伦海峡以南的水道之间。

english: Stokksnes projects into the North Atlantic on Iceland's southeastern coast, near Hornafjörður. Black sand and dunes lie beneath the sharply rising peaks of Vestrahorn, where mountains meet the sea. To the west the great ice cap of Vatnajökull overlooks the coastal country, and rivers descending from its glaciers cross the lowlands. The headland marks a striking change from the open southern shore to the mountainous inlets of eastern Iceland.
simp_chinese: 斯托克角从冰岛东南岸伸入北大西洋，靠近霍尔纳峡湾。黑沙与沙丘位于陡峭的韦斯特拉霍恩山峰之下，山岭在此与海洋相接。西面的瓦特纳冰原俯瞰沿岸地区，冰川流出的河流穿过低地。这处海角标志着开阔的南岸向冰岛东部多山海湾的显著转变。

english: Stolin lies in the heart of Polesia near the Horyn River, where routes lead towards Pinsk, Turov and the south. Archaeological finds show settlement in the area by the twelfth century, while the town's name first appears in a record of 1555. Rivers, marshes and forests shaped the surrounding country, which belonged to the Grand Duchy of Lithuania and later the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth.
simp_chinese: 斯托林位于波列西亚腹地、霍伦河附近，通往平斯克、图罗夫和南方的道路在此交汇。考古发现显示，这一带在十二世纪已有居民，城镇的名字则首见于1555年的记载。河流、沼泽和森林塑造了周围的地貌；这片土地曾属于立陶宛大公国，后来属于波兰立陶宛联邦。

english: Stomio lies on the Thessalian coast near the mouth of the Pineios, where the river reaches the Aegean after passing through the Vale of Tempe. Its older name, Tsagezi, comes from the Turkish words for a river mouth. The ancient town of Eurymenae stood nearby. Above the shore, the monastery of Saint Demetrius occupies a mountain slope; its origins go back to the sixth century, and it was rebuilt in the Byzantine era.
simp_chinese: 斯托米奥位于色萨利海岸，靠近皮尼奥斯河口。河水穿过坦佩谷后，在这里流入爱琴海。它的旧名察盖齐源自土耳其语中的“河口”，古代城镇欧律墨奈也曾坐落在附近。海岸上方的山坡上有圣德米特里修道院，其历史可追溯至六世纪，后来在拜占庭时期重建。

english: Stomoplo Bay lies on the western Black Sea coast near the wooded slopes of Strandzha. A peninsula between the bay and the Ropotamo River ends at the rocky Maslen Nos, where cliffs and offshore rocks break the coast. The headland was inhabited in antiquity, and its fortress guarded the shore. In the thirteenth and fourteenth centuries the harbour of Siva stood on the cape.
simp_chinese: 斯托莫普洛湾位于黑海西岸，靠近斯特兰扎山的林木山坡。海湾与罗波塔莫河之间的半岛止于多岩的马斯伦角，悬崖和离岸岩礁使海岸曲折。古代已有居民居于海角，堡垒守护着这段海岸；十三至十四世纪，锡瓦港也坐落于此。

english: Kincardine gave its name to the old county of Kincardineshire on Scotland's north-east coast. Stonehaven, on the coast south of Aberdeen, later succeeded the older Kincardine as the county town. Stonehaven became a burgh in 1587 and grew in importance as an administrative and coastal centre. Dunnottar Castle stands on a rocky outcrop just south of the town, and in the early 1650s Cromwell's army besieged it for months to seize the Scottish Crown Jewels. The regalia had already been smuggled out by boat to the church at Kinneff, where they stayed hidden for eleven years.
simp_chinese: 金卡丁是苏格兰东北海岸旧金卡丁郡的名称。位于阿伯丁以南海岸的斯通黑文，后来取代较早的金卡丁成为郡治。斯通黑文于1587年成为自治市镇，此后作为行政与海岸中心的重要性逐渐增长。邓诺特城堡坐落在镇南一处岩石岬角上，17世纪50年代初，克伦威尔的军队围攻该堡数月，意图夺取苏格兰王冠珠宝。珠宝此前已被人乘船秘密运往金内夫教堂，在那里隐藏了十一年。

english: Stony Mountain rises above the lowlands south of the Clearwater River. Crow Lake Upland and the May Hills make up this broad area of higher ground, surrounded by plains and wetlands. White spruce, aspen and jack pine grow on well-drained slopes, while black spruce, willow and sphagnum moss occupy the wetter muskeg. Streams descend from the uplands towards the Athabasca and Clearwater river systems, across a landscape shaped by glaciers.
simp_chinese: 石山高出克利尔沃特河南方的低地，克罗湖高地与梅伊山丘共同组成这片广阔的高处，周围则是平原和湿地。排水良好的山坡上生长着白云杉、杨树和短叶松；较湿润的泥沼中则有黑云杉、柳树和泥炭藓。溪流从高地流向阿萨巴斯卡河与克利尔沃特河水系，穿过冰川塑造的土地。

english:
Storebælt, the Great Belt, separates Zealand and Funen and forms a passage between the Baltic and waters leading towards the North Sea. Crossings linked the Danish islands: regular sailing is recorded between the shores in the eleventh century, and in 1653 the postal service established a state-run boat route across the belt.

In the exceptionally cold winter of 1658, the Swedish army crossed the frozen Danish belts during its war with Denmark. From Funen it moved by way of Tåsinge and Langeland across the ice towards Lolland and Zealand. The crossing helped force Denmark into the Treaty of Roskilde, showing how a water barrier could become a route for an army under unusual conditions.
simp_chinese:
大贝尔特海峡位于丹麦西兰岛与菲英岛之间，是波罗的海通向北海方向的水道。横渡海峡的航线连接丹麦各岛：11世纪已有定期航行的记载，1653年邮政机构开设了由国家经营的渡船航线。

1658年异常寒冷的冬季，瑞典军队在对丹麦的战争中踏过封冻的贝尔特海峡。从菲英岛出发，军队经措辛厄和朗厄兰，越冰面向洛兰与西兰推进。这次渡海促使丹麦签订《罗斯基勒条约》，显示水上屏障在特殊条件下也可能成为军队的通路。

english:
Stora Tuna lies in a fertile district along the Dalälven and was a religious and political centre of Dalarna in the later Middle Ages. Its great parish embraced a wide area of farms and mining country. Assemblies met near the church, and medieval records also mention a royal estate at Tuna. The large church, consecrated in 1469, reflected the wealth and standing of the district.

In 1557 Gustav Vasa made Tuna the seat of a superintendent with episcopal authority over Dalarna, though this arrangement did not last. Early in the following century Charles IX planned a town called Gustafs stad near the church and granted it privileges. The project was abandoned, and Falun later became the town centre of the mining region instead. Tuna nevertheless remained an important parish among the cultivated lands of the river valley.
simp_chinese:
大蒂纳位于达尔河畔肥沃地区，中世纪后期是达拉纳的宗教和政治中心。广大的教区包括许多农场与矿业地区，教堂附近举行地方集会，中世纪文书也提到蒂纳的一座王室庄园。1469年祝圣的大教堂反映了地区的财富与地位。

1557年，古斯塔夫·瓦萨使蒂纳成为一位监督长的驻地，赋予他对达拉纳的主教权力，但这一安排并未长久持续。下世纪初，卡尔九世计划在教堂附近建立名为古斯塔夫城的城镇，并授予特权。计划最终被放弃，法伦后来成为矿业地区的城镇中心；蒂纳仍是河谷耕地间重要的教区。

english: Storavan is a long lake in the upper basin of the Skellefte River, downstream from Uddjaure. Its waters lie among the forests and hills of Swedish Lapland, in a chain of lakes that carries the river eastwards towards the Gulf of Bothnia. Before roads crossed this country, the waterways and winter ice offered routes through the interior, where Sámi communities fished and moved with their reindeer.
simp_chinese: 斯图拉万是谢莱夫特河上游的一座狭长湖泊，位于乌迪亚乌尔湖下游。湖水流经瑞典拉普兰的森林与丘陵，汇入一串向东通往波的尼亚湾的湖泊水道。公路穿过这里以前，水道与冬季的冰面便是通行内陆的路径；萨米社群在此捕鱼，并随驯鹿迁徙。

english:
Stordal lies in a valley opening onto Storfjord in Sunnmøre. Its church has served the farming community since the Middle Ages, when a wooden stave church stood on the valley floor. The farmers acquired that old church in the eighteenth century, but its condition eventually made replacement necessary.

In 1789 local farmers built an octagonal timber church, reusing material from its predecessor, including old fittings that had already served generations of worshippers. Ten years later the painters Vebjørn Hamarsbøen and Andreas Reinholdt decorated its interior with vines, roses and biblical scenes on the walls and ceiling. The richly coloured work gave the building its familiar name, the Rose Church, and joined the religious life of the valley to the painting traditions of rural Norway.
simp_chinese:
斯图尔达尔位于孙默勒一条通往斯托尔峡湾的山谷中。中世纪时，谷底已有木制的立柱教堂，服务于当地农民。十八世纪，农民买下了旧教堂，但建筑日渐破败，最终必须重建。

1789年，当地农民建起一座八角形木教堂，重新利用了旧建筑的一部分材料，包括曾供数代信众使用的旧陈设。十年后，画家韦比约恩·哈马尔斯布恩和安德烈亚斯·赖因霍尔特在内部墙壁和天花板上绘制藤蔓、玫瑰及圣经场景。色彩丰富的绘画使它获得“玫瑰教堂”的名称，也将山谷的宗教生活同挪威乡村绘画传统联系起来。

english:
Støren lies in the Gaula valley south of Trondheim, near the confluence of the Gaula and Sokna rivers. Its church is documented in 1432, though the first building was older. In 1665 a replacement was built on higher ground across the Sokna, because flooding and erosion threatened the earlier site.

The church served as a local polling place for the election of representatives to Norway's constituent assembly in 1814. Soon afterwards the old building was found to be dilapidated, and an octagonal timber church was completed and consecrated in 1817. The succession of churches marks Støren's enduring role as a parish centre in the valley.
simp_chinese:
斯特伦位于特隆赫姆以南的高拉河谷，靠近高拉河与索克纳河汇合处。当地教堂于1432年见于文献，但最初建筑更早。由于洪水和河岸侵蚀威胁旧址，1665年人们在索克纳河对岸较高处建起新教堂。

1814年，教堂作为地方投票点，参与选举挪威制宪会议的代表。此后旧建筑年久失修，于1817年建成并祝圣新的八角形木教堂。历代教堂体现了斯特伦作为河谷教区中心的延续。

english:
Storkyro, or Isokyrö, lies in the Kyrö River country of southern Ostrobothnia. It was an ecclesiastical and administrative centre of the old Kyrö parish, and the name Isokyrö was in use for the parish by 1553. Its old stone church, built in the early sixteenth century, stands as a reminder of that parish's long history.

In February 1714, during the Great Northern War, Swedish and Russian forces fought near Napue in the parish. The Russian victory was followed by a period of occupation and severe losses in the district. The battle was part of the wider struggle over Finland while it remained within the Swedish kingdom.
simp_chinese:
斯托屈罗即伊索屈罗，位于芬兰南奥斯特罗博滕的屈罗河流域，是旧屈罗大教区的宗教和行政中心。1553年时教区已使用伊索屈罗之名；16世纪初修建的旧石教堂体现了当地教区的悠久历史。

1714年2月，大北方战争中的瑞典和俄国军队在教区内纳普埃附近交战。俄军获胜后，当地经历占领与严重损失。这场战斗是芬兰仍属瑞典王国期间更广泛战争的一部分。

sources.title: List of medieval stone churches in Finland

english: Stormarn is an old district north of the Elbe, stretching towards the Trave and Bille. Adam of Bremen described it in the eleventh century as the easternmost of the Saxon districts north of the Elbe, bordering the Slavic lands of Wagria. From 1111 the counts of Schauenburg ruled it together with Holstein. Their lands were later divided among several branches, and the territories of Stormarn gradually came under Danish rule by the eighteenth century.
simp_chinese: 施托尔马恩是易北河北岸的古老地区，向东延伸至特拉弗河和比勒河。十一世纪，亚当·冯·不来梅将它描述为易北河北岸最东端的撒克逊地区，与斯拉夫人的瓦格里亚接壤。自1111年起，绍恩堡伯爵将它与荷尔斯泰因一同统治。其领地后来在家族各支之间分割，至十八世纪，施托尔马恩的土地逐渐归于丹麦统治。

english: Storozhynets lies on the Siret in the wooded northern lands of Moldavia. A charter of 18 February 1448 records Prince Roman II granting the village to Petrea, son of Toma; its established boundaries show that the settlement already existed before the grant. Later documents record changes in ownership of the village and its lands. In 1774 Storozhynets passed with Bukovina from the Moldavian principality to the Habsburg monarchy.
simp_chinese: 斯托罗日涅茨位于锡雷特河畔，处在摩尔达维亚北部的林地。1448年2月18日的一份特许状记载，罗曼二世公爵将村庄赐给托马之子佩特雷亚；既有的边界说明聚落在赠与之前已存在。后来的文书记录了村庄及其土地所有权的变迁。1774年，斯托罗日涅茨随布科维纳从摩尔达维亚公国转入哈布斯堡君主国。

english: Storsjön is the great lake at the heart of Jämtland, with the island of Frösön in its waters and the Indalsälven carrying its outflow eastward. Its shores form a settled district amid the forests and mountains of inland Scandinavia. In 1786, King Gustav III founded Östersund on the eastern shore opposite Frösön, hoping to create a Swedish trading town in a region whose commerce had long been drawn westward toward Norway.
simp_chinese: 斯图尔湖是耶姆特兰腹地的大湖，弗勒瑟岛坐落湖中，湖水经因达尔河向东流去。湖岸形成了斯堪的纳维亚内陆森林与山地间的一片聚居区。1786年，古斯塔夫三世在弗勒瑟岛对岸的东岸建立厄斯特松德，希望在这个商业长期面向西方挪威的地区，培育一座瑞典商镇。

english:
Stowbtsy lies on the right bank of the Niemen, where a river landing connected the town with trade downstream. Halshka Kmitianka founded the settlement in 1593 on lands held by the Słuszka family. It later passed to the Denhoff and Czartoryski families; a town hall, church, school and landing with warehouses served its inhabitants and merchants.

The Russo-Polish War devastated Stowbtsy, burning the town and killing many inhabitants. A privilege for markets and fairs followed in 1669 to encourage its recovery. Destroyed again during the Great Northern War in 1706, it received Magdeburg rights in 1729. Russian rule followed the second partition of the Commonwealth in 1793, and French troops ravaged the town in 1812. The Russian government confiscated the Czartoryski estate in 1832 after the uprising of 1830–1831.
simp_chinese:
斯托布齐坐落在涅曼河右岸，河边码头使城镇与下游贸易相连。1593年，哈尔什卡·克米强卡在斯武什卡家族的土地上创建了这处聚落。它后来先后属于登霍夫和恰尔托雷斯基家族；市政厅、教堂、学校以及设有仓库的码头为居民和商人服务。

俄波战争重创斯托布齐，城镇被焚，许多居民丧生。1669年颁发的集市和年市特许权旨在帮助它恢复。1706年大北方战争期间城镇再次遭到毁坏，并于1729年获得马格德堡城市权。1793年联邦第二次被瓜分后，此地归入俄罗斯；1812年法军又劫掠了城镇。1830—1831年起义后，俄国政府于1832年没收了恰尔托雷斯基家族的庄园。

english:
Strabane stands where the Mourne and Finn meet to form the Foyle in western Ulster. A settlement existed before the early seventeenth-century Plantation of Ulster, when the surrounding district was allocated to Scottish undertakers led by James Hamilton, Earl of Abercorn. The town received a royal charter in 1613 and grew around a castle built by Abercorn.

Strabane's position on the Foyle connected its inland hinterland with the sea and supported its growth as a market centre. The Plantation reshaped landholding and settlement in the district, linking the town's development to the wider upheaval of conquest and colonisation in Ulster.
simp_chinese:
斯特拉班位于阿尔斯特西部，莫恩河与芬河在此汇合形成福伊尔河。17世纪初阿尔斯特殖民之前，这里已有聚落；殖民期间，周边地区分配给以阿伯康伯爵詹姆斯·汉密尔顿为首的苏格兰承领人。城镇于1613年获得王室特许状，并围绕阿伯康修建的城堡发展。

福伊尔河将斯特拉班的内陆腹地与海洋联系起来，有利于它发展为市场中心。殖民改变了当地土地占有和定居格局，使城镇成长与阿尔斯特征服和殖民的更广泛动荡紧密相连。

english: The Strait of Bonifacio separates Corsica from Sardinia, joining the Tyrrhenian Sea to the western Mediterranean. At its narrowest the islands stand only eleven kilometres apart. Rocks and small islands crowd the passage: the Lavezzi Islands lie to the north, while the Maddalena archipelago lies to the south. Strong winds and currents add to the danger of its reefs. Above the northern shore, the fortified town of Bonifacio stands on its limestone cliffs facing Sardinia.
simp_chinese: 博尼法乔海峡分隔科西嘉与撒丁岛，连接第勒尼安海和西地中海。最窄处两岛相距仅十一公里。水道中密布岩礁和小岛：拉韦齐群岛在北，马达莱纳群岛在南。强风与海流使礁石更加危险。北岸上方，设防的博尼法乔城立于石灰岩峭壁，隔海面向撒丁岛。

english: The Strait of Hormuz links the Persian Gulf with the Gulf of Oman, between the mountains of Arabia and the Persian coast. At its entrance, Hormuz Island became a wealthy trading centre for ships carrying goods between the gulf and the Indian Ocean. Portuguese forces controlled its port from 1515, building a fortress to guard their position. In 1622 Persian and English forces captured the island, ending Portuguese rule there.
simp_chinese: 霍尔木兹海峡夹在阿拉伯山地与波斯海岸之间，连接波斯湾和阿曼湾。入口处的霍尔木兹岛成为繁荣贸易中心，往来海湾与印度洋的船只在此运输货物。葡萄牙军队从1515年起控制港口，修筑堡垒守卫据点。1622年波斯与英国军队夺取该岛，结束了葡萄牙统治。

english: The Strait of Kerch separates Crimea from the Taman Peninsula and connects the Black Sea with the shallow Sea of Azov. Sandbanks and narrow passages complicate navigation through its waters. In the later Middle Ages Genoese garrisons at Kerch and Matrega watched this gateway, through which merchants sailed toward Tana at the mouth of the Don. Control of the strait gave its holders influence over trade between the two seas.
simp_chinese: 刻赤海峡将克里米亚与塔曼半岛隔开，连接黑海与浅水的亚速海。沙洲和狭窄水道使航行变得复杂。中世纪后期，热那亚人在刻赤和马特雷加驻军，监视这道门户；商人经过海峡，驶往顿河口的塔纳。控制海峡便能影响两海之间的贸易。

english: The Strait of Malta separates the Maltese Islands from the southeastern coast of Sicily. This stretch of the central Mediterranean is roughly forty-five miles wide, and its shallow shelf lies between deeper waters to either side. The prevailing surface current generally flows from northwest to southeast, although strong easterly winds can temporarily reverse it. The channel brings the shores of Sicily and Malta within sight of the same sea, while leaving an open passage between them.
simp_chinese: 马耳他海峡将马耳他群岛与西西里东南岸分开。这段地中海中部水域宽约四十五英里，浅海陆架两侧是较深的海域。表层海流通常从西北流向东南，强劲的东风却可能暂时使其倒转。海峡让西西里与马耳他隔海相望，两岸之间仍是一条开阔的水道。

english: The Strait of Messina separates Sicily from the toe of the Italian peninsula, joining the Tyrrhenian Sea to the Ionian. Its narrow waters are known for strong currents and whirlpools, where opposing flows meet between the two shores. Greek legend placed Scylla on the Calabrian side and Charybdis on the Sicilian side, threatening sailors forced to pass between them. Messina and Reggio face one another across this short but turbulent crossing.
simp_chinese: 墨西拿海峡分隔西西里与意大利半岛南端，连接第勒尼安海和爱奥尼亚海。狭窄水道中相反的水流交会，以强流与漩涡著称。希腊传说将斯库拉置于卡拉布里亚一侧，将卡律布狄斯置于西西里一侧，威胁必须从二者之间穿行的水手。墨西拿与雷焦隔着这条短而湍急的水道相望。

sources.title: Earth from Space The Strait of Messina

english: The Strait of Canso is a narrow channel separating Cape Breton Island from the Nova Scotia mainland. It joins the Gulf of St. Lawrence to the Atlantic, providing a passage between wooded shores. Near its Atlantic approaches, the Canso Islands attracted European fishing crews and Mi'kmaq trading partners; the latter had visited the islands for many centuries. In 1744 an expedition from Louisbourg attacked the British fishing settlement on Grassy Island and burned it.
simp_chinese: 坎索海峡是一条狭窄水道，将布雷顿角岛与新斯科舍大陆分开。它连接圣劳伦斯湾和大西洋，穿行于林木覆盖的两岸之间。靠近大西洋入口的坎索群岛吸引欧洲渔船及其米克马克贸易伙伴，后者到访群岛已有许多个世纪。1744年，一支从路易斯堡出发的队伍袭击并焚毁了格拉西岛上的英国渔业定居点。

english: The Strait of Dover is the narrowest part of the English Channel, separating the chalk cliffs of England from the coast of France. It joins the Channel to the North Sea and has long been crossed by merchants, travellers and armies. Tides run strongly through the narrows, where ships bound between the Atlantic and northern Europe pass close to vessels crossing between the two shores.
simp_chinese: 多佛海峡是英吉利海峡最狭窄的部分，将英格兰白垩悬崖与法国海岸分开。它连接英吉利海峡和北海，商人、旅人与军队长期横渡此处。潮流强劲地穿过狭窄水道，往返大西洋与北欧的船只与横渡两岸的船只在此相遇。

english:
The Strait of Gibraltar separates Iberia from North Africa and joins the Mediterranean to the Atlantic Ocean. At its narrowest, the two shores are only a short crossing apart. Atlantic water flows eastward at the surface, while saltier Mediterranean water moves west beneath it. The Rock of Gibraltar rises above the northern shore, a commanding landmark at the entrance to the inland sea, opposite the mountains of the African shore.

During the War of the Spanish Succession, British and Dutch forces captured Gibraltar in 1704. A Spanish attempt to recover the fortress failed, and the Treaty of Utrecht in 1713 ceded it to Britain. The stronghold remained a focus of conflict: Spain and France besieged it again from 1779 to 1783, but the defenders held out.
simp_chinese:
直布罗陀海峡分隔伊比利亚与北非，连接地中海和大西洋。最窄处两岸相距不远，大西洋海水从表层向东流入，盐度较高的地中海水则从深处向西流出。直布罗陀巨岩耸立于北岸，是内海入口处醒目的地标，与非洲岸边的山地隔水相望。

西班牙王位继承战争期间，英国与荷兰军队于1704年夺取直布罗陀。西班牙试图收复要塞未果，1713年的《乌得勒支条约》将其割让给英国。要塞此后仍是争夺的焦点：1779至1783年，西班牙与法国再次围攻，守军最终坚守了下来。

english:
The Straits of Mackinac join Lakes Michigan and Huron, where islands and narrow passages link the upper Great Lakes. Odawa and Ojibwe communities lived around these waters, which became an important meeting place in the fur trade. Canoes travelling between the eastern lakes and the western interior passed through the straits, bringing traders into contact with people whose routes and relationships already crossed the region and extended far beyond the shores of either lake.

In 1715 French soldiers built Fort Michilimackinac on the southern shore near an Odawa community and a Jesuit mission. British troops took over the fort in 1761. Two years later Ojibwe warriors captured it during the wider uprising against British posts. The fortified trading community was eventually moved to Mackinac Island in 1781.
simp_chinese:
麦基诺海峡连接密歇根湖与休伦湖，岛屿和狭窄水道将五大湖上游各处相连。奥达瓦人和奥吉布瓦人生活在这一带，海峡后来成为毛皮贸易的重要会面地点。往返东部湖区与西部内陆的独木舟穿过这里，商人与早已在地区各处往来的居民相遇；这些联系远远超出两湖的岸边。

1715年，法国士兵在南岸一处奥达瓦社区和耶稣会传教站附近修建米希利麦基诺堡。1761年，英国军队接管堡垒；两年后，奥吉布瓦战士在针对英国据点的广泛起义中攻占此堡。1781年，设防的贸易社区最终迁至麦基诺岛。

english: The Strait of Hormuz joins the Persian Gulf to the Gulf of Oman between the mountains of Arabia and the Persian coast. Ships carrying goods between the Gulf and the Indian Ocean passed through its narrow waters. Portuguese forces seized Hormuz in the early sixteenth century and established a fortress to influence this trade. In 1622 Persian forces and the English East India Company captured the island, ending Portuguese control there.
simp_chinese: 霍尔木兹海峡夹在阿拉伯山地与波斯海岸之间，将波斯湾和阿曼湾相连。往来海湾与印度洋的货船穿过狭窄水道。16世纪初，葡萄牙军队夺取霍尔木兹并筑堡，试图影响这一贸易。1622年波斯军队与英国东印度公司夺取岛屿，结束葡萄牙人在当地的控制。

english: Between southern Italy and the western Balkans, the Strait of Otranto is the gateway from the Ionian Sea into the Adriatic. Its shores face one another across a narrow stretch of water, making the passage important to ships traveling along both coasts. In 1480 an Ottoman fleet under Gedik Ahmed Pasha crossed from Albania and captured Otranto on the Italian side. The occupation lasted until the following year, when forces opposing the Ottomans recovered the town.
simp_chinese: 奥特朗托海峡位于意大利南部与巴尔干西岸之间，是从伊奥尼亚海进入亚得里亚海的门户。两岸隔着狭窄的水域相望，海峡对沿两岸航行的船只都十分重要。1480年，盖迪克·艾哈迈德帕夏率领奥斯曼舰队从阿尔巴尼亚渡海，攻占意大利一侧的奥特朗托。占领一直持续到次年，反奥斯曼军队才夺回这座城镇。

english:
Stralsund stands on the sound separating the island of Rügen from the Pomeranian mainland. Prince Wizlaw I of Rügen granted the settlement Lübeck law in 1234. Merchants and settlers helped it grow into a prosperous port, provoking Lübeck to burn its rival in 1249. Stralsund was rebuilt behind strong walls and joined the Hanseatic League in 1293. Its merchants sent ships across the Baltic, and the town retained considerable independence after Rügen passed to the dukes of Pomerania in 1325.

In 1628, during the Thirty Years' War, imperial troops under Wallenstein besieged Stralsund. The city resisted with Danish and Swedish help, and a Swedish garrison remained; the Peace of Westphalia in 1648 confirmed it as part of Swedish Pomerania. In 1715, in the Great Northern War, King Charles XII himself directed its defence against a coalition of Sweden's enemies. The Congress of Vienna assigned Stralsund to Prussia in 1815, ending nearly two centuries of Swedish rule.
simp_chinese:
施特拉尔松德坐落在分隔吕根岛与波美拉尼亚大陆的海峡岸边。1234年，吕根亲王维茨拉夫一世授予聚落吕贝克法。商人和移民使它发展为繁荣港口，却也招致吕贝克的敌意；1249年，吕贝克焚毁了竞争对手。施特拉尔松德在坚固城墙后重建，并于1293年加入汉萨同盟。商船往来波罗的海；1325年吕根归波美拉尼亚公爵后，城市仍保持相当程度的独立。

1628年三十年战争期间，华伦斯坦率帝国军围攻施特拉尔松德。城市在丹麦和瑞典援助下坚持抵抗，瑞典驻军随后留下，1648年威斯特伐利亚和约确认它属于瑞属波美拉尼亚。1715年大北方战争中，国王卡尔十二世亲自指挥城市抵御反瑞典联军。1815年维也纳会议将施特拉尔松德交给普鲁士，结束了近两个世纪的瑞典统治。

english: Strâmba is associated with a monastery near the Jiu in Oltenia. An earlier hermitage is recorded here in 1525 as a dependency of Cozia monastery. In 1603 the boyar Stoichiță Râioșanu rebuilt the church, establishing a foundation that remained linked to his family. Archaeological work has uncovered traces of the older buildings around the church, a reminder of the long life of this small religious community in the Jiu valley.
simp_chinese: 斯特伦巴与奥尔泰尼亚日乌河附近的一座修道院相联系。1525年的记载提到这里已有一处隶属科济亚修道院的隐修所。1603年，波雅尔斯托伊基察·勒约沙努重建教堂，创立了与其家族保持联系的修院。教堂周围的考古工作发现了旧建筑遗迹，显示这处日乌河谷的小型宗教团体有着悠久历史。

english:
Strängnäs stands on the southern shore of Lake Mälaren, its cathedral rising above the town and the surrounding water. As a bishop's seat, it was a centre of church authority in Södermanland. The cathedral and the bishop's brick residence dominated a town connected by the lake to the other settlements of central Sweden.

On 6 June 1523 an assembly at Strängnäs elected Gustav Eriksson Vasa king of Sweden. His supporters were fighting to break the power of the Danish union king, and Lübeck's support had brought both military help and debts. The election gave Gustav royal authority before his forces took Stockholm, marking a decisive step in Sweden's departure from the Kalmar Union. The bishop's residence beside the cathedral was later drawn into the changing affairs of crown and church.
simp_chinese:
斯特兰奈斯位于梅拉伦湖南岸，大教堂高耸于城镇和周围水域之上。作为主教驻地，它是南曼兰的教会权力中心。大教堂与主教的砖砌住所主宰着城镇景观，而湖泊将此地与瑞典中部其他聚落相连。

1523年6月6日，斯特兰奈斯的集会选举古斯塔夫·埃里克松·瓦萨为瑞典国王。他的支持者正与丹麦联盟国王争夺权力，吕贝克提供的援助既带来军事帮助，也带来债务。选举使古斯塔夫在军队攻取斯德哥尔摩前获得王权，成为瑞典脱离卡尔马联盟的决定性一步。大教堂旁的主教住所后来也卷入王权与教会关系的变化。

english: Stranraer stands at the head of Loch Ryan, a sheltered inlet in the southwest of Scotland. Around 1520 the Adair family built the tower house known as the Castle of St John here, as a residence and centre for their estates. The village became a burgh of barony in 1595 and a royal burgh in 1617. Its harbour and position near the Irish Sea supported fishing and connections across the water.
simp_chinese: 斯特兰拉尔位于苏格兰西南部避风海湾赖恩湖的尽头。约1520年，阿代尔家族在此建造了被称为圣约翰城堡的塔楼宅邸，作为住宅及地产管理中心。村庄于1595年成为男爵自治市镇，1617年又成为王室自治市镇。港湾及其靠近爱尔兰海的位置支撑了渔业和跨海联系。

english:
Strasbourg stands on the Ill near the Rhine, at a crossroads between France and the lands of the Empire. Its cathedral rises above a city of merchants, craftsmen and waterways. Free of episcopal rule since the thirteenth century, Strasbourg became a leading centre of printing on the Upper Rhine after the first presses appeared around 1461. Its workshops supplied books to readers throughout the region.

In the sixteenth century the city became a home of the Reformation. Martin Bucer helped shape its church, and John Calvin found refuge here from 1538 to 1541. Strasbourg surrendered to Louis XIV in 1681 and was annexed to France; its cathedral, used for Protestant worship for much of the preceding century and a half, returned to Catholic use.
simp_chinese:
斯特拉斯堡坐落在莱茵河附近的伊尔河畔，处于法国与帝国诸地之间的交通要冲。大教堂耸立在商人、工匠和水道环绕的城镇之上。十三世纪摆脱主教统治后，斯特拉斯堡成为自由城市；约1461年印刷机在此出现，此地随后发展为上莱茵地区重要的印刷中心，作坊向各地读者供应书籍。

十六世纪，斯特拉斯堡成为宗教改革的重镇。马丁·布策参与建立当地教会，让·加尔文也于1538至1541年在此避难。1681年，城市向路易十四投降，被法国吞并；此前约一个半世纪的大部分时间里用于新教礼拜的大教堂重新交还天主教会。

english: Stratford-upon-Avon is a market town on the River Avon in Warwickshire. Its bridge, guild chapel and timber-framed houses speak of the prosperity of the late medieval town. William Shakespeare was born here in 1564, the son of a glovemaker, and attended the local grammar school. Although his career as a playwright and actor took him to London, he retained ties to Stratford and was buried in its church of Holy Trinity in 1616.
simp_chinese: 埃文河畔斯特拉特福是沃里克郡的一座集镇。桥梁、行会礼拜堂和木架房屋展现了中世纪晚期城镇的繁荣。威廉·莎士比亚于1564年出生于此，父亲是一名手套匠，他本人曾就读当地文法学校。虽然剧作家和演员的生涯将他带到伦敦，他仍与斯特拉特福保持联系，并于1616年安葬在圣三一教堂。

english:
The Strathcona mountain country belongs to Vancouver Island in the forested Pacific Northwest. High ridges, lakes and river valleys lie inland from coastal communities. The wider area includes the traditional territory of the Mowachaht and Muchalaht peoples, whose relationships with land and water connect mountain country to the island's shores.

Before sustained European contact, Indigenous communities maintained territories, political institutions and ceremonial relationships across the wider region. Knowledge of routes and seasons enabled them to use different parts of the landscape. Maritime visits and expanding trade in the late eighteenth and early nineteenth centuries brought new goods, disease and pressure to coastal societies, whose connections with the interior were already established.
simp_chinese:
斯特拉科纳山区位于太平洋西北部的温哥华岛，高山、湖泊和河谷分布在沿海社区的内陆。广大地区包括莫瓦查特与穆查拉特人的传统领地；他们与土地、水域的关系将山区同岛屿海岸联系起来。

持续接触欧洲人之前，广大地区的原住民社群已有领地、政治制度和仪式联系。他们利用对路线和季节的了解，在不同地点获取资源。十八世纪后期至十九世纪初，海上造访和贸易扩张给沿海社会带来新货物、疾病与压力；这些社群与岛屿内陆的联系则早已存在。

english: Strathearn is the valley of the River Earn in Perthshire, extending from the Highland hills towards the Tay. South of Crieff stands Drummond Castle, seat of a family whose fortunes became closely tied to the Stuart cause. The Drummond estates were forfeited after the family's involvement in the Jacobite rising of 1745. The castle and its formal gardens overlook the broad valley and its farms.
simp_chinese: 斯特拉森是珀斯郡的恩河谷地，从高地山丘向泰河方向延伸。克里夫以南矗立着德拉蒙德城堡，这个家族的命运与斯图亚特事业紧密相连。家族参与1745年詹姆斯党起义后，德拉蒙德地产被没收。城堡及其规整的花园俯瞰宽阔的河谷和农田。

english: Straubing stands on the Danube in Lower Bavaria, beside the fertile Gäuboden. In 1353 it became the capital of the Wittelsbach duchy of Bavaria-Straubing, whose rulers also held lands in the Low Countries. After that branch ended in 1425, an inheritance settlement assigned the town to Bavaria-Munich. Its town tower, begun in 1316, and St James's church, begun around 1395, mark the prosperity of this ducal period. In 1507 Straubing became the seat of a Bavarian administrative district. The Thirty Years' War brought occupation and plague in 1633, while later eighteenth-century wars and a major fire in 1780 again damaged the town. Its market remained important to the surrounding agricultural country.
simp_chinese: 施特劳宾位于下巴伐利亚多瑙河畔，靠近肥沃的盖博登农区。1353年，它成为维特尔斯巴赫家族巴伐利亚－施特劳宾公国的首府，该支统治者也拥有低地地区的领土。1425年这一支系绝嗣后，继承仲裁将城镇划归巴伐利亚－慕尼黑。1316年开建的市塔和约1395年开建的圣雅各教堂，见证了公爵时代的兴盛。1507年，施特劳宾成为巴伐利亚一个行政区的驻地。三十年战争期间，1633年的占领和瘟疫给城市造成沉重损失；十八世纪的战争和1780年大火又带来破坏。尽管如此，它仍是周围农业地区的重要市场。

english:
Straupe grew around a castle of the Rosen family on a road north of Riga. The fortified residence and its church stood beside a small medieval trading town known in German as Roop. Granted town privileges in 1374, Straupe belonged to the Hanseatic trading world, and its location brought merchants through the lands of the Archbishop of Riga.

The Polish–Swedish War devastated both town and castle. Swedish troops occupied Straupe in 1600, Polish forces followed in 1601, and control changed repeatedly. By 1624 the church was roofless and the castle described as damaged and largely empty. The ruined town was not restored to its former standing, and the settlement became a village while the castle continued as the centre of a landed estate.
simp_chinese:
斯特劳佩围绕罗森家族的一座城堡发展起来，位于里加以北的道路上。设防府邸及其教堂旁边，是一座德语名为罗普的小商镇。1374年，斯特劳佩获得城市特权，属于汉萨贸易网络；商人经过这里，往来于里加总主教的领地。

波兰与瑞典的战争严重破坏了城镇和城堡。瑞典军队于1600年占领斯特劳佩，波兰军队次年到来，此后控制权反复易手。到1624年，教堂已失去屋顶，城堡也被描述为受损且大部分空置。遭毁城镇未能恢复原有地位，聚落逐渐变为村庄，城堡则继续作为庄园中心。

english:
Strehaia was an early seat of the Craiovești boyars, a family whose influence extended across Oltenia and the court of Wallachia. Their estate and church stood at the heart of the settlement. For a time Strehaia housed the ban, the chief official of Oltenia, before the seat moved to Craiova at the end of the fifteenth century; the village retained its connection to the family and their descendants.

Prince Matei Basarab, himself connected to the Craiovești, rebuilt the monastery church in 1645. The monastery became one of the important princely foundations of Oltenia. Between 1673 and 1688 it also housed the bishopric of Strehaia, established for Daniil, a former metropolitan of Sofia who had fled to Wallachia. Its jurisdiction covered the district of Mehedinți.
simp_chinese:
斯特雷哈亚是克拉约韦什蒂波雅尔家族早期的驻地。这一家族的影响遍及奥尔泰尼亚及瓦拉几亚宫廷，其庄园和教堂位于聚落中心。奥尔泰尼亚的最高官员巴恩曾在此驻留，十五世纪末治所迁往克拉约瓦；村庄仍与这个家族及其后裔保持联系。

与克拉约韦什蒂家族有渊源的公爵马泰·巴萨拉布于1645年重建了修道院教堂。修院成为奥尔泰尼亚重要的公爵捐建机构之一。1673年至1688年间，斯特雷哈亚主教座也设于此，供从索非亚逃至瓦拉几亚的前都主教达尼伊尔使用，其辖区包括梅赫丁茨地区。

english: Strelcha lies in a valley on the southern slopes of Sredna Gora, beside the Strelchanska Luda Yana. Above the river stood Strelchansko Kale, a fortified settlement that guarded this part of the mountain country from the ninth to the fourteenth century. A town known as Strelch or Strelets grew below the stronghold. Under Ottoman rule, sheep breeding was among the occupations of the inhabitants; men from Strelcha also appear in sixteenth-century Ottoman military registers.
simp_chinese: 斯特雷尔恰坐落在中山南坡的河谷里，濒临斯特雷尔恰卢达亚纳河。河岸高处曾有斯特雷尔恰堡垒，第九至十四世纪间，这座设防聚落守卫着附近的山地。堡垒下方逐渐形成一座名为斯特雷尔奇或斯特雷莱茨的城镇。奥斯曼统治时期，养羊是当地居民的生计之一；十六世纪的奥斯曼军籍中也记载了来自斯特雷尔恰的人。

english:
Strelitz takes its name from a Polabian word for archers. First recorded as a village in 1278, it grew into a small town and belonged in the seventeenth century to Mecklenburg-Güstrow. After that ruling line ended, the Duchy of Mecklenburg-Strelitz was established in 1701, comprising lands around Strelitz and an outlying territory near Ratzeburg.

Fire destroyed the town and its castle in 1712. The duke and his family withdrew to their hunting lodge beside Lake Zierke, north-west of the old and damaged town. A new settlement, Neustrelitz, grew around the lodge and became the ducal capital in the 1730s. Old Strelitz continued to exist as a small village after the disaster, while the new ducal residence gave its name to the surrounding duchy.
simp_chinese:
施特雷利茨的名字源于波拉布语中「弓手」一词。它于1278年首次作为村庄见诸记载，后来发展为小城，十七世纪属于梅克伦堡—居斯特罗。该统治支系绝嗣后，梅克伦堡—施特雷利茨公国于1701年成立，包括施特雷利茨周围的土地和拉策堡附近的一块飞地。

1712年，大火焚毁城镇和城堡。公爵一家迁往旧城西北、齐尔克湖畔的一处狩猎宫，新的聚落新施特雷利茨在宫邸周围兴起，并于十八世纪三十年代成为公国首府。旧施特雷利茨在灾后继续存在，而新的驻地则继承了周围公国的名称。

english: Streshyn stands on the right bank of the Dnieper, where an old fortified site occupied a promontory above the river. The Vilnius cathedral chapter acquired the district in 1391. In 1399 Grand Duke Vytautas confirmed lands between Streshyn and Rahachow to the canons, placing the river settlement within the possessions of the church. A charter of King Casimir IV in 1480 mentions Streshyn among the places where a merchant was permitted to trade without paying duties. The river linked the small town to a wider route through the Lithuanian lands.
simp_chinese: 斯特列申位于第聂伯河右岸，一处古老的设防遗址占据河上岬地。1391年，维尔纽斯主教座堂参事会取得该地区；1399年，维陶塔斯大公确认参事们拥有斯特列申与罗加乔夫之间的土地，使河畔聚落成为教会地产的一部分。1480年，卡齐米日四世国王的一份特许状将斯特列申列为一位商人获准免税贸易的地点之一。河流将这座小镇与贯穿立陶宛土地的更广阔通道联系起来。

english: Lake Strobel lies on a high Patagonian plateau scattered with lakes and basaltic rock. The surrounding landscape preserves rock paintings and archaeological sites that reveal the presence of Indigenous hunters. Together with the neighbouring Lake Cardiel basin, the plateau formed part of a network of places used by people moving across southern Patagonia over many generations.
simp_chinese: 斯特罗贝尔湖位于巴塔哥尼亚高原，周围散布着湖泊与玄武岩。附近保存的岩画和考古遗址显示了原住民猎手在此活动的痕迹。这片高原与邻近的卡尔迭尔湖盆地一道，构成了历代居民穿行南巴塔哥尼亚时所利用的地点网络。

english:
Strömstad lies at the mouth of the Strömsån on the rocky coast of northern Bohuslän. A settlement called Strömmen grew here by the sixteenth century. Its harbour and its proximity to the Norwegian border shaped the town that followed, as merchants, fishermen and soldiers all found reasons to gather on this coast.

After Bohuslän passed to Sweden in 1658, the crown sought a trading centre in the north of the province. Strömstad became a market town in 1667 and a town by 1672. During the wars of Charles XII it served as his headquarters for operations against Norway, and in 1717 Danish naval forces under Tordenskjold attacked it twice. Later in the eighteenth century the great herring fishery brought new prosperity to the small port.
simp_chinese:
斯特伦斯塔德位于布胡斯伦北部多岩的海岸，斯特伦河在此入海。至16世纪，这里已有名为斯特伦门的聚落。港湾与临近挪威边境的位置塑造了后来的城镇，也使商人、渔民和士兵汇聚于此。

1658年布胡斯伦归属瑞典后，王室希望在该省北部建立贸易中心。斯特伦斯塔德于1667年成为集镇，至1672年已为城镇。卡尔十二世对挪威作战时以此为司令部，1717年托登舍尔领导的丹麦舰队两度袭击此地。18世纪后期，兴盛的鲱鱼渔业又为小港带来繁荣。

english:
Strumica stands in a fertile basin in southeastern Macedonia, beneath the hill known as the Tsar's Towers. The town takes its name from the Strumica River, a tributary of the Struma that flows through the basin. In Roman times it was called Tiberiopolis; in the Middle Ages, Byzantine, Bulgarian and Serbian rulers successively held the town and its surrounding country.

After the Ottoman conquest in 1383, Strumica became known as Ustrumca. Turkic pastoralists settled in the area, and the town's Christian and Muslim communities appear in Ottoman tax registers. In 1519 the register counted 1,450 Christians and 1,330 Muslims. By the seventeenth century Strumica was the seat of a local judicial district, and the Ottoman travellers Haji Khalifa and Evliya Çelebi described its Islamic buildings.
simp_chinese:
斯特鲁米察坐落在马其顿东南部的盆地中，城上方的山丘称作“沙皇之塔”。城镇得名于斯特鲁米察河，这条河是斯特鲁马河的支流。罗马时代这里称为提比里奥波利斯；中世纪，拜占庭、保加利亚和塞尔维亚统治者先后控制了城镇及周边地区。

1383年奥斯曼人征服此地后，城镇被称作乌斯特鲁姆贾。突厥牧民在附近定居，奥斯曼税册中也记载了城中的基督徒和穆斯林社区。1519年的登记列有1450名基督徒和1330名穆斯林。到十七世纪，斯特鲁米察成为一个司法辖区的治所，旅行家哈吉·哈利法与埃夫利亚·切勒比都曾描述城中的伊斯兰建筑。

english: Stryi takes its name from the river on whose left bank it stands, at the foot of the Carpathians. First mentioned in 1385, it grew as a trading town on the route between Halych and Lviv. It received Magdeburg rights in 1431 and was governed by a magistrate and burgomaster. The town's prosperity was interrupted by repeated raids. Tatars destroyed Stryi in 1523, and it was rebuilt with a castle for defence; another Tatar attack devastated it in 1634. In 1772 the first partition of Poland transferred the town to the Habsburg monarchy. The castle, once a feature of its defences, was dismantled under Austrian rule later in the eighteenth century.
simp_chinese: 斯特雷坐落在喀尔巴阡山麓、斯特雷河左岸，城镇以河流命名。它首见于1385年的记载，在哈雷奇与利沃夫之间的道路上发展为贸易城镇。1431年，斯特雷获得马格德堡法权，由市政官员和市长治理。反复的袭击打断了城镇的繁荣。1523年，鞑靼人摧毁斯特雷；城镇重建时修筑城堡以资防御，1634年又遭鞑靼人袭击。1772年第一次瓜分波兰后，斯特雷转归哈布斯堡君主国。曾是防御设施一部分的城堡，于十八世纪后期在奥地利统治下被拆除。

english: East of Chalcidice, the Strymonian Gulf receives the river from which it takes its name. Near the river mouth stood Eion, the port of ancient Amphipolis, which Athens used as a military and commercial base. After Amphipolis declined, its inhabitants likely moved to the port, rebuilt by the Byzantines as Chrysopolis. In 1367 two Byzantine officials built a fortified tower nearby to protect lands they had given to the monastery of Pantokrator on Mount Athos.
simp_chinese: 斯特里蒙湾位于哈尔基季基半岛以东，得名于注入海湾的斯特里蒙河。河口附近曾有古代安菲波利斯的港口埃伊翁，雅典人将其用作军事和商业据点。安菲波利斯衰落后，居民很可能迁往港口；拜占庭人重建此地，称其为克里索波利斯。1367年，两名拜占庭官员在附近修筑一座设防塔楼，保护他们赠予阿索斯山潘托克拉托修道院的土地。

english: Stryn lies at the inner end of Nordfjord, where steep mountains rise above the waters and valleys of western Norway. The district's churches served farms scattered between fjord and mountain. At Nedstryn a medieval stave church was replaced around 1650 by a timber church with a cruciform plan. At nearby Olden another wooden church was completed in 1759 on a plain beside a branch of the fjord.
simp_chinese: 斯特林位于北峡湾内端，挪威西部的陡峭山岭耸立在水面和山谷之上。当地教堂服务于散布在峡湾与群山之间的农庄。约1650年，内德斯特林的中世纪木板教堂被一座十字形木教堂取代；附近奥尔登的另一座木教堂则于1759年在峡湾支湾旁的平地上建成。

english: Strzelce grew from a market settlement on the road between Opole and Kraków. Its castle, first mentioned in 1303, guarded the southern side of the town, with marshes beyond it. In the fourteenth century the castle became the residence of Duke Albert, who ruled a separate Silesian principality here. After the death of the last Piast duke of Opole in 1532, the castle passed to the Habsburg king Ferdinand. Later in the century Georg von Redern began a lengthy rebuilding of the old fortress as a Renaissance residence; his family acquired Strzelce outright in 1615.
simp_chinese: 斯切尔采由一处市集聚落发展而来，位于奥波莱与克拉科夫之间的道路上。当地城堡最早见于1303年，守护着城镇南侧，城堡之外则是大片沼泽。十四世纪，城堡成为阿尔贝特公爵的驻地，他在此统治一个独立的西里西亚小公国。1532年，最后一位奥波莱皮雅斯特公爵去世，城堡转归哈布斯堡国王斐迪南。本世纪后期，格奥尔格·冯·雷德恩开始长时间改建旧要塞，将其变为文艺复兴式府邸；1615年，他的家族正式购得斯切尔采。

english: The inland country west of the Darling River gives way to dry plains, dunes and intermittent watercourses. Farther west lies the Strzelecki Desert, where long sand ridges flank the floodplains of Cooper Creek. Aboriginal peoples have travelled and lived along the inland rivers that cross this arid region.
simp_chinese: 达令河以西的内陆地带逐渐转为干旱平原、沙丘和间歇性水道。更西方是斯特泽莱茨基沙漠，长形沙脊分布在库珀溪洪泛平原两侧。原住民族长期沿穿过这片干旱地区的内陆河流生活和往来。

english: The Sts'ailes homeland encompasses Harrison Lake and the rivers that flow south toward the Fraser. Salmon return to these waters, while the forests around ancestral villages supplied plants such as crabapple and hazelnut. Sts'ailes tradition tells how Xá:ls cast the heart of Shay into the river, where it came to rest near the meeting of the Harrison and Chehalis rivers and gave the people their name, the beating heart.
simp_chinese: 斯特赛勒斯人的家园包括哈里森湖及向南流往弗雷泽河的诸条河流。鲑鱼洄游至此，祖先村落周围的森林则提供野苹果和榛子等植物。斯特赛勒斯人的传统讲述，哈尔斯将沙伊的心脏抛入河中，它落在哈里森河与奇黑利斯河交会附近，赋予了这里“跳动的心”这一名称。

english: Stswecem'c, the Canoe Creek people, are part of the Northern Secwépemc of the Fraser River country. Their neighbors include the people of Dog Creek, another community of the same wider nation. Salmon moving upstream through the Fraser and its tributaries provided a major food source, while the plateau and its valleys offered hunting and gathering grounds beyond the riverbank.
simp_chinese: 斯特斯韦森克人又称卡努溪人，属于弗雷泽河流域的北方塞克韦佩姆克人。邻近的多格溪人也是这一更大民族的社群之一。沿弗雷泽河及其支流溯流而上的鲑鱼提供重要食物，高原与河谷则在河岸之外提供猎场和采集地。

english: Stung Treng lies at the meeting of the Sekong and the Mekong in northern Cambodia. The Sekong gathers the waters of the Sesan and Srepok from the eastern highlands, while the Mekong flows south past islands and flooded forests. This confluence connects the inland river valleys with the Cambodian lowlands. In the late eighteenth and early nineteenth centuries, the region lay between the competing ambitions of Siam and Vietnam.
simp_chinese: 上丁位于柬埔寨北部色公河与湄公河的汇合处。色公河汇集来自东部高地的色桑河与斯雷波河水量，湄公河则向南流经岛屿和淹水森林。汇流处将内陆河谷与柬埔寨低地相连。十八世纪末至十九世纪初，这片地区处于暹罗与越南争夺的势力之间。

sources.title: GENOCIDE EDUCATION IN CAMBODIA--Public Education Forum in Stung Treng.pdf

english: The dry interior west of the Darling River contains stony plains and seasonal watercourses. Farther west, the Sturt Stony Desert is covered by a pavement of closely packed stones rather than the tall dunes found in neighboring deserts. Aboriginal routes crossed the arid interior, following its scarce water and seasonal changes.
simp_chinese: 达令河以西的干旱内陆分布着石砾平原和季节性水道。更西方的斯特尔特石漠覆满密集石砾，与邻近沙漠的高沙丘截然不同。原住民道路穿越干旱内陆，依循稀少水源与季节变化。

english:
Stuttgart lies in a basin on three sides closed in by hills, where a stud farm, the Stuotgarten that gave the town its name, was founded in the tenth century, traditionally by Duke Liudolf of Swabia. The settlement came to the Counts of Württemberg in 1251 as the dowry of Mechthild of Baden. In 1286 King Rudolf I besieged the town and razed its walls, and in 1312 to 1315 the city of Esslingen administered it after the Württembergers fell out with Emperor Henry VII. Count Eberhard I then made it, from 1317, his strengthened residence, because it was safer from Esslingen than the old Württemberg castle; about 1320 the canons and the Württemberg tombs were moved from Beutelsbach to the collegiate church. He had begun a moated castle on the site of the later Old Castle about 1302.

In 1495 Stuttgart became the seat of the duchy of Württemberg. Duke Ulrich's quarrel with Reutlingen and the Swabian League put Württemberg under Habsburg rule from 1520 to 1534; peasants held the city for a few days in 1525, and Ulrich brought in the Reformation through Erhard Schnepf on his return. Duke Christoph had a new wall built about 1565 around the suburbs, and Aberlin Tretsch turned the castle into a Renaissance palace between 1553 and 1578. After the defeat at Nördlingen in 1634 the duke fled to Strasbourg, Habsburg rule lasted until 1638, plague struck in 1637, and the population fell from about 10,000 to fewer than 5,000.

In 1718 the court moved to Ludwigsburg, and Stuttgart regained the role of main residence only under Duke Carl Alexander, whose financial adviser Joseph Süss Oppenheimer was judicially murdered after his death. Carl Eugen laid the foundation stone of the New Palace in 1746. Stuttgart became capital of the Electorate of Württemberg in 1803 and of the new kingdom in 1806, and held its first Cannstatt fair in 1818.
simp_chinese:
斯图加特位于三面被山丘环抱的盆地里，10世纪在此建立了一座马场（Stuotgarten），城名由此而来，传统上认为创建者是施瓦本公爵柳多尔夫。1251年，聚落作为巴登的梅希希尔德的嫁妆归于符腾堡伯爵。1286年鲁道夫一世国王围攻城镇并拆毁城墙；符腾堡人与皇帝亨利七世交恶后，1312至1315年由埃斯林根城代管。随后埃伯哈德一世伯爵从1317年起加固斯图加特，将其作为伯爵驻地，因为这里比旧符腾堡城堡更能抵御埃斯林根；约1320年，教士团和符腾堡家族的墓地从博伊特尔斯巴赫迁到合议教堂。他约在1302年已在后来旧宫的位置动工兴建一座水堡。

1495年，斯图加特成为符腾堡公国的驻地。乌尔里希公爵与罗伊特林根和施瓦本同盟的冲突使符腾堡在1520至1534年间归哈布斯堡统治；1525年农民占领城市数日，乌尔里希返回后经埃哈德·施内普夫引入宗教改革。克里斯托夫公爵约在1565年围着郊区修起新城墙，阿贝林·特雷奇在1553至1578年间把城堡改建为文艺复兴宫殿。1634年讷德林根战败后，公爵逃往斯特拉斯堡，哈布斯堡的统治持续到1638年，1637年又遭瘟疫，人口从约一万人降到不足五千。

1718年宫廷迁往路德维希堡，直到卡尔·亚历山大公爵时斯图加特才重新成为主要驻地，他的财务顾问约瑟夫·祖斯·奥本海默在他死后被司法谋杀。1746年卡尔·欧根为新宫奠基。1803年斯图加特成为符腾堡选侯国首府，1806年成为新王国的首都，1818年举办了首届坎施塔特民俗节。

english: The West Kettle River rises in the mountains east of Okanagan Lake and winds south through the wooded highlands. It joins the Kettle River, whose course loops south across the border before returning to British Columbia and eventually reaching the Columbia. The tributary's mountain valleys lie between the Okanagan lakes to the west and the Columbia country to the east.
simp_chinese: 西凯特尔河发源于奥肯纳根湖以东的山区，蜿蜒向南流过森林覆盖的高地。它汇入凯特尔河；凯特尔河向南跨越边界，随后返回不列颠哥伦比亚，最终注入哥伦比亚河。西凯特尔河的山谷位于西方的奥肯纳根湖群与东方的哥伦比亚河流域之间。

english: The Stz’uminus are a Coast Salish people of the sheltered waters on southeastern Vancouver Island. Around the harbour later called Oyster Harbour, they established fishing camps and gathered fish and shellfish from the shore. Families also travelled along the coast and across the water towards the mouth of the Fraser River. Nets, harpoons and trolling lines served in the fisheries, while large houses sheltered several families, especially in winter.
simp_chinese: 斯特祖米努斯是温哥华岛东南部避风水域一带的海岸萨利希人。他们在后来被称为牡蛎港的海湾周围建立捕鱼营地，从岸边采捕鱼类和贝类。家庭也沿海岸旅行，渡海前往弗雷泽河口一带捕鱼狩猎。渔人使用鱼网、鱼叉和拖钓线，大屋则为多个家庭提供居所，冬季尤其如此。

english: Sun’aq is the Alutiiq name associated with Kodiak, on the northeastern coast of Kodiak Island. Archaeological sites show that Alutiiq people lived in the area for millennia; the historic Native village of Tangirnaq lay on nearby Woody Island. The name Sun’aq was originally used for the Russian settlement at Three Saints Bay. It travelled to Kodiak when the Russian colonial capital was moved there, where the settlement became known as St. Paul’s Harbor.
simp_chinese: 苏纳克是与科迪亚克岛东北岸科迪亚克相关的阿留提克语名称。考古遗址表明，阿留提克人数千年来居住在这一带；历史时期的原住民村落坦吉尔纳克位于附近的伍迪岛。苏纳克一名原先用于三圣湾的俄国聚落，后来随着俄属美洲首府迁至科迪亚克而转移到这里；此处的聚落也被称作圣保罗港。

english: Sua is one of the great salt pans of the Makgadikgadi, a vast basin left by an ancient lake. For much of the year its pale surface lies dry beneath the Kalahari sun, but rains can turn the flats into shallow water. Around the pans, communities gathered salt for use and exchange; in the Nata area, hunters also followed animals drawn to pools near the salt-bearing ground.
simp_chinese: 苏阿是马卡迪卡迪的大盐盘之一，这片广阔盆地是古代湖泊留下的遗迹。一年中的大部分时间，浅色的盐地在卡拉哈里阳光下干燥裸露；雨季到来时，平坦的洼地又会变成浅湖。盐盘周围的居民采集食盐，用于生活和交换；在纳塔地区，猎人也追寻被盐地附近水塘吸引而来的野兽。

english:
Suakin is an island port on the western shore of the Red Sea, linked to the mainland by a causeway. Its merchants traded across the sea and along caravan roads into the Sudanese interior, while pilgrims embarked here for Jeddah and the holy cities of Arabia. Houses and mosques built of local coral stone gave the island a distinctive appearance among the ports of the Red Sea.

Already known as a trading port in the Middle Ages, Suakin grew in importance as routes to the Nile and inland markets developed. Ottoman forces made it a port of their empire in the sixteenth century. The administrative building known as Beit el Basha rose on the island around the middle of that century, as stone construction became more widespread. Suakin remained a meeting place for merchants, pilgrims and the communities of the surrounding coast.

The later city of Port Sudan also lies here.
simp_chinese:
苏阿金是红海西岸的一座岛上港口，堤道将它与大陆相连。商人横渡红海贸易，也沿商队道路深入苏丹内陆；朝圣者则在这里登船，前往吉达和阿拉伯的圣城。用当地珊瑚石建造的住宅与清真寺，使岛城在红海诸港中独具风貌。

中世纪时，苏阿金已是知名商港；随着通往尼罗河和内陆市场的道路发展，它的重要性日益增长。十六世纪，奥斯曼军队将苏阿金纳入帝国港口。约在该世纪中叶，岛上建起名为“帕夏之家”的行政建筑，石造建筑也变得更加普遍。苏阿金始终是商人、朝圣者和周围海岸社群的交会之地。

后来的苏丹港也位于此地。

english: The Suakin Archipelago stretches along the African shore of the Red Sea, south of the island port of Suakin. Its low islets include rocky land formed from raised coral, with reefs and shallow water between them. Suakin was a centre of trade and a departure point for pilgrims crossing to Jeddah. Sailors navigating this coast had to find their way among the islands and reefs before reaching the harbour.
simp_chinese: 萨瓦金群岛沿红海非洲海岸从萨瓦金岛港向南延伸。低平小岛中有抬升珊瑚形成的岩地，岛间分布礁石和浅水。萨瓦金是贸易中心，也是朝圣者横渡红海前往吉达的出发地。沿岸水手须在岛屿与礁石之间辨认航路，才能抵达港湾。

english: Suamox, later Sogamoso, was a major religious centre of the Muisca on the Colombian highland. Its ruler, the iraca, held spiritual authority among neighbouring communities. Chroniclers described a great temple of the Sun built of timber and woven cane with a thatched roof. The fertile valley around the sanctuary supported a substantial settlement before Spanish conquest. In 1537 Gonzalo Jiménez de Quesada’s expedition reached Suamox seeking the wealth reported to be held there. The temple burned during the Spaniards’ occupation, an event recorded by colonial chroniclers. The Indigenous settlement endured under the new colonial order, although its institutions and religious life were transformed. The memory of Suamox remained bound to the sacred valley and its place in Muisca traditions.
simp_chinese: 苏阿莫克斯即后来的索加莫索，是哥伦比亚高原穆伊斯卡人的重要宗教中心。其统治者伊拉卡在邻近社群中拥有精神权威。编年史家描述了一座用木材、编织苇杆和茅草屋顶建成的太阳大神殿。西班牙征服之前，圣所周围肥沃谷地已有规模可观的聚落。1537年，贡萨洛·希门尼斯·德克萨达的远征队为寻找传闻中的财富抵达苏阿莫克斯。西班牙人占据期间，神殿被火焚毁，殖民编年史对此有所记载。原住民聚落在新的殖民秩序下延续，但其制度与宗教生活发生改变。苏阿莫克斯的记忆仍与这片神圣谷地及其在穆伊斯卡传统中的地位紧密相连。

english: Sumprabum lies in the northern uplands of Burma, amid mountains drained by the Mali and its tributaries. The Kumon Range rises to the west, while streams thread the forested valleys toward the Irrawaddy headwaters. Steep ridges divide the region into many small valleys, making the rivers and mountain paths important guides through a landscape that is difficult to cross.
simp_chinese: 苏安普拉邦位于缅甸北部高地，周围群山由迈立开江及其支流排水。库蒙山脉耸立在西面，溪流穿过林木茂密的河谷，流向伊洛瓦底江源区。陡峭山脊将地区分成许多小谷地，河流和山路因此成为穿行这片险阻地形的重要路径。

english: Suan lies in the hills of inland Hwanghae, northeast of the Chaeryŏng plain. In 1310, under Koryŏ, it was raised to the status of Suju. One account attributes this to the influence of a local man at the Yuan court; another credits a man who obtained grain to relieve famine. The Joseon government renamed it Suan in 1417, and appointed county magistrates from 1450.
simp_chinese: 遂安位于黄海道内陆丘陵，载宁平原的东北方。高丽时期的1310年，此地升为遂州。一种说法将此归功于在元廷任职的当地人，另一说则认为是为了酬谢筹得赈灾粮食的人。朝鲜政府于1417年将此地改名遂安，自1450年起派驻郡守。

english: Suau is an Austronesian language of the southeastern tip of New Guinea and nearby islands. Its coastal communities live among bays and channels leading from the mainland towards the island groups of the Massim region. Canoe voyages linked the shores with neighbouring islands, where shell valuables circulated through the kula network alongside food, tools and other goods.
simp_chinese: 苏奥语是新几内亚东南端及附近岛屿使用的一种南岛语言。沿岸社群生活在众多海湾与水道之间，这些水道从本土通向马西姆地区的岛群。独木舟航行连接海岸与邻岛，贝饰珍品与食物、工具等物品一起，在库拉交换网络中流通。

english: The Subansiri descends from the eastern Himalaya to join the Brahmaputra in the Assam plain. Its course cuts through steep mountain country before reaching the broad lowlands, carrying water and sediment from the high valleys. The river was known for the gold in its sands: before colonial rule, people washed its deposits in the Himalayan foothills to recover the precious metal. Its name thus recalls both a formidable mountain river and a source of alluvial gold.
simp_chinese: 苏班西里河从东喜马拉雅山流下，在阿萨姆平原汇入布拉马普特拉河。它先穿过陡峭的山地，再进入广阔低地，将高山谷地的水流和泥沙带向平原。这条河以沙中的黄金闻名：殖民统治之前，人们曾在喜马拉雅山麓淘洗河砂以取得贵金属。苏班西里因而既是一条险峻的山河，也是一处砂金产地。

sources.title: 327861021 Quest for Himalayan Gold Need for reappraisal of Subansiri River prospect

english: Subaytila, the ancient Sufetula, stands on a plateau in central Tunisia. Its Roman ruins include a forum with three temples dedicated to Jupiter, Juno and Minerva. The town prospered through cultivation of grain and olives in the surrounding countryside. In 647 an Arab army defeated the forces of the Byzantine ruler Gregory near the city, an important episode in the conquest of North Africa.
simp_chinese: 苏拜提拉即古代的苏费图拉，坐落在突尼斯中部高原。罗马遗迹包括广场及三座分别供奉朱庇特、朱诺和密涅瓦的神庙。周围乡村种植谷物和橄榄，带来城镇繁荣。647年，阿拉伯军队在城附近击败拜占庭统治者格雷戈里的军队，这是征服北非过程中的重要事件。

english: The Sierra Mágina rises south of the Guadalquivir valley in the Subbaetic ranges. Its limestone heights include Pico Mágina, more than two thousand metres high, and a network of caves shaped by water dissolving the rock. The Guadalbullón borders the massif to the west, while the Guadiana Menor lies to the east. Towns including Jódar and Bedmar stand around the mountain's foothills.
simp_chinese: 马希纳山地耸立在瓜达尔基维尔河谷以南，是次贝蒂科山脉的一部分。石灰岩高地包括海拔两千多米的马希纳峰；流水溶蚀岩石，还造出众多洞穴。瓜达尔布永河在山地西侧流过，瓜迪亚纳梅诺尔河则位于东面。霍达尔和贝德马尔等城镇坐落在山麓周围。

english: The Subi Islands belong to the southern part of the Natuna group in the South China Sea. They lie among the islands scattered between the Malay Peninsula and Borneo, south of Great Natuna. Small island shores and surrounding reefs interrupt the open sea, where channels link the Natuna group with neighbouring archipelagos.
simp_chinese: 苏比群岛属于南海纳土纳群岛的南部，位于大纳土纳岛以南、马来半岛与婆罗洲之间散布的岛屿之中。小岛海岸和周围礁石点缀开阔海面，水道将纳土纳群岛与邻近岛群相连。

english: The Subi Islands form a small group in the southern Natuna waters of the South China Sea. Their shores and surrounding reefs lie between Great Natuna to the north and the coast of Borneo to the east. Subi was counted among the island groups known collectively as the Seven Islands, linked to the Malay sultanates of the Riau world. Boats and knowledge of the channels between islands were essential in a region where the sea connects widely scattered communities.
simp_chinese: 苏比群岛是南海纳土纳南部水域中的一小群岛屿。岛岸与周围礁区位于北方大纳土纳岛和东方婆罗洲海岸之间。苏比是历史上统称“七岛”的诸岛之一，与廖内世界的马来苏丹国有联系。这里的社群散布广阔海域，舟船和对岛间水道的了解是往来所必需的。

english: Suççun lies on the right side of the Alazeya valley in the Kolyma Lowland. The river winds through a landscape of lakes and wetlands, with larch woods and willows along its banks. Permafrost underlies the plain, and its waters flow north toward the East Siberian Sea through a country of long winters and brief summers.
simp_chinese: 苏琼位于科雷马低地阿拉泽亚河谷的右岸一侧。河流在湖泊与湿地之间蜿蜒，岸边生长着落叶松林和柳丛。平原下方是永久冻土，河水穿过冬季漫长、夏季短暂的北方土地，流向东西伯利亚海。

english:
Suceava lies on the Suceava river at the edge of the Carpathian foothills in northern Moldavia, where Prince Petru Mușat moved the capital from Siret and issued a charter dated in Suceava Fortress in 1388. For nearly two centuries it was the princely seat of Moldavia, with a wooden princely house inside the fortress that Alexander the Good rebuilt after 1400 with stone walls. In 1401 the Moldavian metropolitan church was established here, and the Mirăuți church served as its cathedral.

Alexander the Good gave Lviv merchants trade privileges in 1408, and Suceava became a storage point for cloth and Moldavia's export goods. Under Stephen the Great, who reigned from 1457 and died here in 1504, the fortress was rebuilt in stone. In 1476 Sultan Mehmed II failed to take it, and in 1497 the Polish king's cannon battered its walls for twenty-one days without success. After Alexandru Lăpușneanu moved the capital to Iași in the mid-1560s, the fortress declined; Michael the Brave held Suceava briefly in 1600, and it was destroyed in 1675. In 1775 the town passed to the Habsburgs with Bukovina.
simp_chinese:
苏恰瓦位于喀尔巴阡山麓摩尔达维亚北部的苏恰瓦河畔，彼得鲁·穆沙特大公把首都从锡雷特迁到这里，1388年的一份特许状就签发于苏恰瓦要塞。近两个世纪里它是摩尔达维亚大公的驻地，要塞内有一座木质大公府，亚历山大“善良者”在1400年后用石墙重建了它。1401年摩尔达维亚都主教区在此设立，米劳茨教堂充当主教座堂。

1408年亚历山大“善良者”授予利沃夫商人贸易特权，苏恰瓦成为呢绒和摩尔达维亚出口货物的存储地。1457年起在位的“大”斯特凡于1504年在此去世，期间要塞以石料重建。1476年苏丹穆罕默德二世攻城未果，1497年波兰国王的火炮连轰二十一天，城墙依然屹立。1560年代中期亚历山德鲁·拉普什内亚努把首都迁往雅西后，要塞逐渐衰败；1600年勇敢的米哈伊曾短暂占据苏恰瓦，1675年要塞被毁。1775年，苏恰瓦随布科维纳划归哈布斯堡。

english:
Süchiimma is the Wayuunaiki name for Riohacha, on Colombia's Caribbean coast at the mouth of the Ranchería River. The wider Guajira region was home to Wayuu communities whose connections linked the coast and interior. Fishing, cultivation where water allowed, and later livestock herding formed part of varied local livelihoods.

Spanish colonization brought settlements, missions and new claims to land and labour, but control over the peninsula remained uneven. Wayuu communities maintained commercial relationships with European traders, including British and Dutch merchants, outside Spanish official channels. The region's coastal history reflects both Indigenous ties to the land and the changing pressures and opportunities of Atlantic trade.
simp_chinese:
苏奇马是里奥阿查的瓦尤语名称，位于哥伦比亚加勒比海岸的兰切里亚河河口。更广阔的瓜希拉地区是瓦尤人的家园，社群之间的联系连接海岸与内陆。捕鱼、有水处的耕作，以及后来发展的畜牧，构成多样的地方生计。

西班牙殖民带来聚落、传教活动及对土地和劳动的新要求，但对半岛的控制并不均衡。瓦尤社群同英国、荷兰等欧洲商人保持商业联系，其中一些交易绕过西班牙官方渠道。这片海岸的历史既体现原住民与土地的联系，也反映大西洋贸易带来的压力与机会。

english: Suchilapan lies beside the Coatzacoalcos River in the lowlands of the Isthmus of Tehuantepec, near the mouth of a tributary bearing the same name. Its Nahuatl name combines words for a flower and water. The settlement grew from a riverside cluster of fishermen known as El Súchil; the rivers of this district join the broad Coatzacoalcos on its course toward the Gulf of Mexico.
simp_chinese: 苏奇拉潘位于特万特佩克地峡低地的夸察夸尔科河畔，靠近同名支流的河口。其纳瓦特尔语名称由“花”和“水”的词语组合而成。聚落源于河岸上一群渔民的居处，名为埃尔苏奇尔；这一带的河流汇入宽阔的夸察夸尔科河，继续流向墨西哥湾。

english: The Sucuriú rises on the uplands east of the Paraguay basin and flows southeast to the Paraná. Its tributaries drain a broad region of the Brazilian interior, where wooded valleys cut through higher open country. Although the surrounding plateau lies near the headwaters of rivers flowing toward the Pantanal, the Sucuriú belongs to the Paraná system and carries its waters eastward.
simp_chinese: 苏库里乌河发源于巴拉圭流域以东的高地，向东南流入巴拉那河。其支流为巴西内陆广大地区排水，树木覆盖的河谷切穿较高的开阔地带。附近高原上也有流向潘塔纳尔的河流源头，但苏库里乌河属于巴拉那水系，将水向东带去。

english: Sudai lay on the eastern frontier of the Galich lands, among the forests and rivers beyond Chukhloma. The fortified town is known to have existed by 1536, and a reference to its fortress survives from 1542. Together with Bui and Kady it formed part of the line built against raids from the direction of Kazan. By the middle of the seventeenth century Sudai was the military and administrative centre of a district encompassing several substantial rural volosts.
simp_chinese: 苏代位于加利奇土地的东部边缘，坐落在楚赫洛马之外的森林与河流之间。可以确定这座设防城镇在1536年已存在，1542年的记载则提到了它的堡垒。苏代与布伊、卡德伊共同构成防线，抵御来自喀山方向的袭击。到十七世纪中叶，苏代已成为一个辖区的军事和行政中心，下辖若干较大的乡村区。

english: Sudislavl grew up east of Kostroma around a timber kremlin. Its earliest surviving documentary mention occurs in the testament of Ivan IV in 1572, though a later chronicle of the local Resurrection monastery claimed that the town existed in 1360. In the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries it was known as a merchant town. Local merchants paid for several stone churches, and Old Believers became the dominant religious community in the surrounding district.
simp_chinese: 苏季斯拉夫尔在科斯特罗马以东发展起来，城中曾有木制克里姆林。现存文献最早在1572年伊凡四世的遗嘱中提到此地，但当地复活修道院后来编写的编年史称，城镇在1360年就已存在。十七至十八世纪，苏季斯拉夫尔以商人城镇闻名。当地商人出资兴建了多座石教堂，旧礼仪派也成为周边地区主要的宗教群体。

english: Sudogda stands on the river of the same name in the forest country between Vladimir and Murom. Recorded as a postal settlement in 1552, it lay on the route joining those towns. In the seventeenth century the Sudogda settlement belonged to the state clerk Ivan Gryazev and, after his death in 1640, to Moscow's Simonov Monastery. Catherine II made it a district town in 1778. Its district status was briefly withdrawn in 1796 and restored in 1803, while the road and river continued to shape the settlement.
simp_chinese: 苏多格达位于弗拉基米尔与穆罗姆之间的森林地带，坐落在同名河流畔。1552年，它作为连接两城道路上的驿站聚落见于记载。十七世纪，苏多格达聚落属于国家文官伊凡·格里亚泽夫；他于1640年去世后，聚落转归莫斯科的西蒙诺夫修道院。1778年，叶卡捷琳娜二世将它升为县城。1796年其县治地位暂被撤销，1803年又得到恢复；道路与河流则继续塑造着当地生活。

english:
Sudzha stands beside the river of the same name, near its meeting with the Psel. It grew on the forest-steppe frontier where Ukrainian migrants and Cossacks settled under Russian rule. The town's wooden fortifications and surrounding slobodas formed part of the network of settlements that spread south and west of Kursk in the seventeenth century.

After an early settlement was damaged by fire, the government established a fortress town here in 1664 and appointed Gerasim Ragozin as its voivode. Its defences included a small inner fort surrounded by a ditch and a larger enclosure with fourteen towers, four of them containing gates. Sudzha became a company town of the Sumy Cossack regiment, whose organization combined military service with local administration in Sloboda Ukraine.
simp_chinese:
苏贾坐落在同名河流旁，靠近该河与普肖尔河的汇合处。它兴起于森林草原边疆，乌克兰移民和哥萨克人在俄罗斯统治下迁居于此。城镇的木制防御工事及周围的斯洛博达，是十七世纪向库尔斯克以南和以西扩展的聚落网络的一部分。

早期聚落遭火灾破坏后，政府于1664年在此建立要塞城镇，任命格拉西姆·拉戈津为总督。防御设施包括一座有壕沟环绕的小型内堡和外围城郭；外围有十四座塔楼，其中四座设有城门。苏贾成为苏梅哥萨克团下属的百人队城镇，该团在斯洛博达乌克兰兼管军事服务与地方行政。

english: Suena is a Papuan language of the mountainous country of eastern New Guinea. It belongs to the northern branch of the Binanderean languages, related to languages spoken farther east towards the Solomon Sea. Forested ridges and river valleys separate communities across this part of the peninsula, whose waters drain from the interior towards the coast.
simp_chinese: 苏埃纳语是新几内亚东部山地的一种巴布亚语言，属于比南德雷语族的北部分支，与更东面所罗门海方向的语言有关。森林山脊与河谷分隔半岛这一带的社群，河水从内陆流向海岸。

english:
Suez stands at the northern end of the Red Sea, where a desert route leads west to the Nile Valley. Its harbor connected Egypt with Jeddah, the Arabian coast and the maritime routes of the Indian Ocean. Goods arriving by sea could be carried overland toward Cairo and the Mediterranean.

After the Ottoman conquest of Egypt in 1517, Suez became a naval and commercial station. Ships built and maintained at its arsenal served the routes of the Red Sea, while Ottoman fleets contested Portuguese power farther south. Timber was scarce in Egypt and had to be brought from distant lands. In the eighteenth century Indian wood supplied the shipyards, whose vessels helped carry provisions to the holy cities of Mecca and Medina.
simp_chinese:
苏伊士位于红海北端，一条沙漠道路从这里向西通往尼罗河谷。港口将埃及与吉达、阿拉伯海岸及印度洋航路连接起来。海运货物可以从此地经陆路运往开罗和地中海。

1517年奥斯曼人征服埃及后，苏伊士成为海军和商业据点。港口船厂建造和维修的船只服务于红海，奥斯曼舰队则在更南方与葡萄牙争夺势力。埃及木材稀少，须从远方运来。十八世纪，印度木材供应苏伊士船厂，这些船只协助向麦加和麦地那两座圣城运送补给。

english: Sufaynah is an old village in the uplands southeast of Medina, with wells, palm gardens and mud-built houses. A branch of the Iraqi pilgrimage road passed through it, and caravans stopped to replenish their supplies. The village is remembered as the home of the poet al-Khansa, who named Sufaynah in elegies for her brothers Sakhr and Mu'awiya. Fortified buildings and a wall protected the older settlement beside the road.
simp_chinese: 苏法纳是麦地那东南高地上的古老村庄，有水井、棕榈园和泥筑房屋。伊拉克朝觐道路的一条支线经过此地，商队在此停留补充物资。这里被记为诗人汉莎的故乡，她在悼念兄长萨赫尔和穆阿维叶的诗中提到了苏法纳。设防建筑和城墙保护着道路旁的旧聚落。

english:
Sagar lies around a lake in the central Indian uplands, among low wooded hills and the country drained by the Sonar River. Its name is commonly connected with the large expanse of water beside the town. A fort and settlement grew here as power in Bundelkhand passed between local chiefs and the Marathas.

Around 1660 Udan Shah built a small fort and founded the nearby village of Parkota. After the district came into the Peshwa’s possession in the eighteenth century, his officer Govind Rao Pandit built a larger fort and developed the settlement beneath its walls. Sagar became a centre of Maratha authority in the surrounding country. In 1818 Peshwa Baji Rao II ceded much of the territory to the British, bringing another change of rulers to the lakeside town.
simp_chinese:
萨加尔环绕一座湖泊而建，位于印度中部高地，周围是低矮林丘和索纳尔河流域。据说城名与湖泊宽广的水面有关。随着本德尔坎德的权力在地方首领和马拉塔人之间转移，堡垒与聚落在湖边发展起来。

约1660年，乌丹沙修建小堡，并在附近建立帕尔科塔村。十八世纪，该地区进入佩什瓦的领地后，其官员戈文德·拉奥·潘迪特修建更大的堡垒，发展城墙下的聚落。萨加尔成为马拉塔人在周围地区的权力中心。1818年，佩什瓦巴吉·拉奥二世将大部分领土割让英国，这座湖畔城镇再次易主。

english:
Sugeneb, better known as Sumenep, lies at the eastern end of Madura. It was the seat of a line of rulers whose influence extended across the island and into the politics of eastern Java. The court's later palace combined Javanese, Chinese, Islamic and European elements, a reflection of the many contacts that reached Madura by sea.

In 1269 Arya Wiraraja took his seat at Sumenep as ruler of Madura under Singhasari. His support helped Raden Wijaya establish Majapahit after the fall of Singhasari, and Wiraraja was rewarded with a domain in eastern Java centred on Lumajang. Sumenep remained a distinct seat of power as Javanese kingdoms rose and fell across the strait. In the eighteenth century Panembahan Sumolo had a new palace built, with the Chinese architect Louw Phia Ngo credited with its design. Its halls and gateways testified to the continuing importance of the Madurese court amid the expanding power of the Dutch East India Company.
simp_chinese:
苏格涅布更常被称为苏默讷普，位于马都拉岛东端。这里是一支统治家族的驻地，其影响延及全岛及爪哇东部的政治。王廷后来修建的宫殿融合爪哇、中国、伊斯兰和欧洲元素，反映了经海路到达马都拉的多种联系。

1269年，阿里亚·维拉拉查在苏默讷普就任马都拉统治者，臣属于信诃沙里。信诃沙里覆灭后，他的支持帮助拉登·维查亚建立满者伯夷；作为回报，他获得了以卢马姜为中心的爪哇东部领地。海峡对岸的爪哇王国兴衰更替，苏默讷普仍保持独立的权力中心。十八世纪，帕南巴汉·苏莫洛修建新宫殿，传由华人建筑师娄披亚吴设计。殿堂与门楼见证了荷兰东印度公司势力扩张之际马都拉王廷的持续重要性。

english:
Sughar, the ancient Zoara, lay near the southern end of the Dead Sea in a warm, fertile valley watered by streams from the eastern hills. Date palms and other crops grew in the lowlands, and the town stood on routes between the Transjordanian plateau and southern Palestine. In the Islamic period its fields and workshops became known for a valuable crop: sugar cane.

From the eleventh to the late fourteenth century, cane was processed on a substantial scale at nearby Tawahin al-Sukkar. Mills crushed the stalks and workshops produced vessels used in refining the sugar. The Ayyubids and Mamluks invested in irrigation in the Jordan Valley, and by the fourteenth century sugar was an important commercial product under close Mamluk control. Pottery and the remains of presses preserve the traces of this industry around Sughar.
simp_chinese:
苏哈尔即古代的佐阿拉，位于死海南端附近温暖肥沃的河谷，东面山地流下的溪水滋润低地。这里生长椰枣等作物，城镇也处在外约旦高原通往巴勒斯坦南部的道路上。伊斯兰时期，附近田地和作坊以一种贵重作物闻名：甘蔗。

十一世纪至十四世纪末，附近的塔瓦欣苏卡尔大规模加工甘蔗。磨坊压榨茎秆，作坊制作精炼糖时使用的陶器。阿尤布和马穆鲁克王朝投资约旦河谷的灌溉，到十四世纪，糖已成为重要商品，生产与销售受到马穆鲁克统治者严密控制。陶器和榨坊遗迹保存着苏哈尔周围这一产业的痕迹。

english: The Sugut River flows through the forested country of northeastern Borneo toward the Sulu Sea. Its tributaries rise among inland hills before joining the lower river and its wetlands. The Terusan Sugut area became a trading center for forest products, drawing goods from the river basin toward the coast. Communities along its tributaries relied on the river and its fish as well as the surrounding forest.
simp_chinese: 苏古特河穿过婆罗洲东北部森林地带，流向苏禄海。支流发源于内陆丘陵，再汇入下游河道与湿地。特鲁桑苏古特一带曾成为林产贸易中心，将流域货物引向海岸。支流沿岸的社群既依靠河流和鱼类，也利用周围的森林。

english:
Suhar stands on Oman's Batinah coast, where a fertile plain meets the sea routes of the Indian Ocean. In the early Islamic centuries it was among the great ports of the region. Medieval writers described a prosperous city of numerous houses, and finds of Omani copperwork, glass and Chinese ceramics show the range of its connections. Its harbour linked the products of the interior to merchants sailing across the Arabian Sea.

The town's fortunes changed as shipping and political power shifted. By the later Middle Ages, ports on the Persian side of the Gulf had gained importance, while Suhar's earlier prominence diminished. In 1507 the Portuguese commander Afonso de Albuquerque reached the town during his campaign along the Omani coast. The Portuguese held a fort here, but its shallow approaches made Suhar less suitable than Muscat for their larger ships. Persian and Portuguese forces contested the position in the early seventeenth century. Imam Nasir ibn Murshid of the Yaruba brought much of Oman together and challenged Portuguese control. His forces recovered Suhar in 1643. The fortress remained a visible reminder of the struggle for the Batinah coast, even as Muscat grew in importance as Oman's principal maritime centre.
simp_chinese:
苏哈尔位于阿曼巴提纳海岸，肥沃平原在此接临印度洋航路。伊斯兰教兴起后的早期几个世纪，它是这一地区的重要港口之一。中世纪作家描述这座繁荣城市拥有众多房屋；出土的阿曼铜器、玻璃和中国陶瓷显示其联系之广。港口将内陆产品与航行阿拉伯海的商人连接起来。

航运和政治力量的变化改变了城镇的命运。到中世纪后期，海湾波斯沿岸港口日益重要，苏哈尔昔日的地位逐渐下降。1507年，葡萄牙指挥官阿方索·德·阿尔布克尔克沿阿曼海岸进军时抵达此地。葡萄牙人在此占据堡垒，但浅水入口使苏哈尔不如马斯喀特适合大型船只。十七世纪初，波斯与葡萄牙军队争夺这一据点。雅鲁巴家族的伊玛目纳西尔·伊本·穆尔希德联合阿曼广大地区，挑战葡萄牙人的控制。他的军队于1643年收复苏哈尔。堡垒继续见证对巴提纳海岸的争夺，而马斯喀特则日益成为阿曼主要的海上中心。

sources.title: Omani Seafaring Identity before the Earl-1.pdf

english: Şuhut stands on the site of ancient Synnada, a city of Phrygia in the Anatolian interior. Synnada gave its name to a prized ornamental marble quarried at nearby Docimeion: its pale stone, marked with purple veins, travelled far beyond the plateau. Inscriptions from the city and its surroundings preserve the names and dedications of people who lived here under Roman rule, when the settlement was an administrative centre for the surrounding district.
simp_chinese: 舒胡特位于古代弗里吉亚城邑辛纳达的旧址，地处安纳托利亚内陆。附近多基梅翁出产一种珍贵的装饰石材，因辛纳达而得名；这种带有紫色纹理的浅色大理石远销高原之外。城中及周边的铭文留下了居民的姓名与献辞，见证了罗马统治时期这里作为周边地区行政中心的地位。

english: Sui lies in the sandy country north of Bikaner, within the dry plains of Jangladesh. This region became part of the kingdom founded by Rao Bika in the late fifteenth century. Rainfall is uncertain, and the desert landscape supports thorny plants and grasses used by herding communities. Wells and seasonal water sources sustained settlements and travellers crossing between Bikaner and the northern desert.
simp_chinese: 苏伊位于比卡内尔以北的沙地，处在疆加尔德什干燥平原中。十五世纪末，拉奥·比卡建立的王国将这一地区纳入领地。这里降雨不稳定，沙漠中生长着牧民利用的耐旱草类与刺生植物。水井和季节性水源维系着聚落，也为往返比卡内尔与北部沙漠的旅人提供水。

english: Sui lies in the dry hills and plains of the Bugti country, east of Sibi and west of the Indus. The region has long been associated with Baloch pastoral communities, whose grazing grounds extend across rugged uplands and seasonal watercourses. Paths through this country connect the Indus plain with the interior of Balochistan. Rainfall is sparse, and settlements depend on the limited water available from streams and wells.
simp_chinese: 苏伊位于布格蒂地区的干燥山地与平原，处在锡比以东、印度河以西。这里长期与俾路支牧民社群有关，他们的牧场延伸于崎岖高地和季节性水道之间。穿越这一地区的小路连接印度河平原与俾路支斯坦内陆。降雨稀少，聚落依靠溪流和水井提供的有限水源。

english: Sui'an was a county seat in the mountainous country of western Zhejiang, under Yanzhou Prefecture in the Ming and Qing. Its town stood beneath the hills known as Five Lions Mountain. After an uprising reached Sui'an in 1513, the magistrate Rong Jiuxiao organised the construction of walls. In 1574 another magistrate extended the defences northward, carrying them onto the steep slopes of the mountain.
simp_chinese: 遂安是浙江西部山区的县城，明清时期属严州府，城北有五狮山。1513年，王浩八起事波及遂安，平定后知县容九霄主持修筑城墙。1574年，知县吴撝谦又向北扩建，将城墙筑上险峻的山坡。

english: Suichang lies among the mountains of southwestern Zhejiang, in the historical region of Chuzhou. The county's valleys supported farming communities, while paths connected settlements across wooded hills. The Ming playwright and official Tang Xianzu served as magistrate here from 1593 to 1598. Local accounts remember his encouragement of agriculture and education, as well as his literary work: he wrote the celebrated play The Peony Pavilion while serving in Suichang. Mining also had a long history in the county; local accounts trace gold and silver extraction back to the Tang period. Suichang's history thus brings together the practical concerns of a mountain county and the literary culture of the late Ming.
simp_chinese: 遂昌位于浙江西南山区，历史上属于处州地区。河谷容纳农耕村落，山路穿过林地，连接各处聚落。明代戏曲家、官员汤显祖于1593年至1598年在此任知县。地方记载称他劝农兴教，他也在遂昌任上写下著名戏曲《牡丹亭》。县内采矿同样历史悠久，地方资料将金银开采追溯到唐代。遂昌的历史由此结合了山地县域的实际生活与晚明士人的文学世界。

english:
